0x000.name: check_api_version
0x000.desc: LevelSetup's version check: returns 1 for (1, 7, 0x8D8); anything else shows the 'Level script is out of date and needs re-building' box (0x5EDB40, FUN_004b98d0) and exits on Abort.

0x004.name: load_anim
0x004.returns: int (1 loaded or already loaded, 0 unknown state / bad file)
0x004.desc: Registers an animation for a named animation state: finds the state name in the table 0x5EDF28 (0x38-byte entries), loads the .prs through the anim manager FUN_00500a40([0x63C968]) into entry +0x34; unknown name -> 'Anim slot name not defined in code!' box, already loaded -> 'Attempt to load anim twice!' box, load failure -> 'bad anim' box; load time added to [0x60F580].

0x008.name: load_anim_by_index
0x008.returns: int (1 loaded / already loaded, 0 bad anim)
0x008.desc: Same as load_anim but takes the state's index in the table 0x5EDF28 directly (no name lookup); boxes 'Attempt to load anim twice!' / 'bad anim' as there. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x00C.name: load_sound_bank
0x00C.desc: Loads a .sbk sound bank (e.g. "Mission1.sbk") through the sound manager (FUN_0055dd20(mgr, name, 1)) and returns the bank.

0x010.name: load_sound_bank_alt
0x010.desc: Loads a .sbk sound bank like load_sound_bank (0x0C) but with flag 0 (FUN_0055dd20(mgr [0x63C9AC], name, 0)); the flag only reaches FUN_00560580, which ignores it, so it behaves the same. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x014.name: get_sample_id
0x014.returns: int (ELF hash id, 0 if missing or empty)
0x014.desc: Hashes a sample / stream file name (FUN_00560530: ELF hash FUN_004b9bf0) and returns it if the level sound cache has it (FUN_0055e2d0), else logs 'Sample "%s" is not in the sound cache!' and returns 0; same lookup as get_stream_id (0x18) - the differing extra arguments are ignored. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x018.name: get_stream_id
0x018.desc: Looks up a speech/cutscene stream by file name ("OBJ_M1_1A.wav", "CS_INTRO_S01.psf"): ELF hash of the name, checked against the loaded stream table; returns the id or 0.

0x01C.name: play_sample
0x01C.desc: Plays a sample id (from get_sample_id) once, non-positional, volume 1.0, min distance 1000 (FUN_0055df60 -> FUN_0055e300 on the sound manager [0x63C9AC]); nothing if sound is off ([mgr+0x12E0] = 0). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x020.name: start_sound_emitter
0x020.desc: Starts a managed non-positional sound emitter for a sample id in one of 30 slots at sound manager +0x880 (0x38 bytes each; FUN_005600c0 with min distance 400, volume 1.0) and returns the slot as a handle for stop_sound_emitter (0x24). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x024.name: stop_sound_emitter
0x024.desc: Stops an emitter started by start_sound_emitter (0x20): sets bit 2 of slot +0x34 (FUN_005600a0); the handle is passed by value so the caller's copy is not cleared. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x028.name: play_stream
0x028.desc: Stops the current stream and starts this one at full volume (FUN_0055f840); the load time is logged ("Lost time = %d") and up to 5000 ms of it is added back to both game timers so scripted timing does not jump.

0x02C.name: play_stream_flagged
0x02C.desc: Like play_stream (0x28) without the load-time compensation: stops the current stream (FUN_0055f820) and starts this one (FUN_0055f890 -> FUN_0055e400), which also sets voice flag 8 (probably looping / music-style playback; not confirmed). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x030.name: stop_stream_alt
0x030.desc: Identical to stop_stream (0x34): stops the playing speech / cutscene stream (FUN_0055f820 on [0x63C9AC]). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x038.name: play_music_cue
0x038.desc: Plays event `cue` of the level's music bank ([0x6182f0], loaded from <level>Music.sbk at level init), e.g. 0x17; mission end uses 0x19.

0x03C.name: preload_stream_stub
0x03C.desc: No-op on PC (xor eax,eax; ret). Training DLLs call it with .psf names - a console stream preload left as a stub.

0x040.name: unused_0x040
0x040.desc: Empty function (ret). Only Training DLLs call it, with varying arguments; does nothing on PC.

0x044.name: load_scene
0x044.desc: Loads the level scene .env (FUN_0040b580) incl. the loading screen texts.

0x048.name: set_zone_object_table
0x048.desc: Copies a script table {u32, u32, groups*, group count; group = {entries*, count}; entry = {object id, active flag}} into the game ([0x617DA8]); activate/deactivate/respawn then update the flags of listed objects, and is_active (0xC0) reports a living soldier listed with flag 1 as active. Likely per-zone object streaming lists.

0x04C.name: load_map_image
0x04C.desc: Loads the mission map image sheet ("GWMission1.img") into the map sheet [0x60EE20].

0x050.name: set_map_image
0x050.desc: Selects the image of the map sheet used as the level map ([0x6107C0]) and resets the map's world bounds to the level's bounds.

0x054.name: set_map_bounds
0x054.desc: Sets the world area the map image covers: size = max - min, origin = min (the code stores min.x as origin y too - y is unused by the map).

0x058.name: load_level_strings
0x058.desc: Loads the mission's text file ("M01Strs.loc") into the text catalog (FUN_004f56d0).

0x05C.name: disable_route_marker
0x05C.desc: Takes an AI route marker out of the network (FUN_00503fc0 on [0x63C9C0]): clears its 5 links (FUN_00504540), sets marker flag 0x20 (FUN_005045c0), removes it from its quadtree leaf when flag bit 0 is set (FUN_00505f80 on [0x63C9BC]) and marks the set dirty (+0x18); other markers' links to it are not removed (the loop meant for that calls FUN_00504600 on the same marker). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x060.name: link_markers
0x060.desc: Adds an AI route link from marker `from` to `to` (FUN_00504550), and back when both_ways = 1.

0x064.name: unlink_markers
0x064.desc: Removes the route link from -> to (and to -> from when both_ways); if anything was removed the route set is flagged for recomputing (set +0x18 = 1).

0x068.name: clear_look_target
0x068.desc: Clears the soldier's watched object (soldier +0x2594 = 0) set by 0x6C.

0x06C.name: set_look_target
0x06C.desc: Sets soldier +0x2594 = target object; the soldier's update reads the target's position from it (head/aim tracking of another object).

0x070.name: get_ladder_count
0x070.desc: Number of ladders registered by the scene ([0x63C9B4]+0x2D0); scripts register the ladder-climb animations only when it is non-zero.

0x074.name: spawn_birds
0x074.desc: Creates an ambient boid flock (hloboid.c) of `count` (min 10) objects inside region `region`.

0x080.name: set_time_of_day_speed
0x080.desc: Sets how fast the hour advances (atmosphere +0x40, game seconds per real second).

0x084.name: set_timer_scale
0x084.desc: Sets the time scale (+0x28) of timer [0x63C954] (slow motion / speed-up of that clock). Only Mission7 calls it.

0x088.name: get_timer_scale
0x088.desc: Returns the time scale (+0x28) of timer [0x63C954] (pairs with set_timer_scale 0x84). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x08C.name: blend_timer_scale
0x08C.desc: Ramps timer [0x63C954]'s time scale towards target at rate per second (FUN_004ba500: +0xD8 = 1, +0xDC target, +0xE0 rate; applied in the timer update 0x4BA7B6 until reached) - smooth slow motion in / out. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x090.name: run_time_of_day_until
0x090.desc: Lets the hour advance until `hour`, then stops (atmosphere +0x44 = 1, +0x48 = hour).

0x094.name: get_time_ms
0x094.desc: Current game time in ms ([0x63C954]+0x10). Used for all script delays.

0x098.name: get_gameplay_time_ms
0x098.desc: Returns the gameplay timer's total ms ([0x63C958]+0x10) - the clock that pauses with the game (0x94 reads timer [0x63C954]). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x09C.name: get_time_whole_seconds
0x09C.desc: Returns timer [0x63C954]'s total ms / 1000 (whole seconds). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x0A0.name: get_waypoint_position
0x0A0.desc: Copies the waypoint's position into out and returns out (hidden struct-return argument first).

0x0A4.name: set_waypoint_next
0x0A4.desc: Sets the waypoint a unit walks to after this one (waypoint +0x18; -1 = end of path).

0x0AC.name: set_waypoint_wait
0x0AC.desc: Sets how long a unit waits on arrival at this waypoint (+0x1C, added to the arrival time; soldier +0x238 = end of wait).

0x0B0.name: team_near_waypoint
0x0B0.desc: 1 if any object in the team's lists 0 and 1 (vehicles and soldiers, FUN_004c9720([0x63C9A0], team, list)) is within distance (cm, 3-D, FUN_004cc210) of the waypoint. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x0B4.name: team_soldier_near_waypoint
0x0B4.desc: As team_near_waypoint but only the team's list 1 (soldiers). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x0B8.name: set_object_field_2af4
0x0B8.desc: Writes object +0x2AF4. For soldiers it is a waypoint index (-1 = a random waypoint is picked; read in FUN_00413b30, apparently a spawn/respawn point); vehicles use the same offset as a count. Called for squad members with waypoint-like values.

0x0BC.name: is_unit
0x0BC.desc: Calls the object's vtable +8 (non-zero for soldiers/AI units - the game uses it to choose unit-only code paths); 0 if the id is unknown.

0x0C0.name: is_active
0x0C0.desc: 1 if the object is in play (+0xC bit 0); a living soldier listed with flag 1 in the zone object table (0x48) also counts as active.

0x0C4.name: activate_object
0x0C4.desc: Brings an object into play (vtable SetActive(1) unless already in play) and records it in the zone object table.

0x0C8.name: deactivate_object
0x0C8.desc: Takes an object out of play (SetActive(0)) and records it in the zone object table.

0x0CC.name: activate_objects
0x0CC.desc: activate_object for each id in an int array (ids pointer, count).

0x0D0.name: activate_living_objects
0x0D0.desc: activate_object for each id in the array that is not dead (is_dead 0x100 = 0).

0x0D4.name: deactivate_objects
0x0D4.desc: deactivate_object for each id in an int array.

0x0D8.name: set_ai_flag_80000
0x0D8.desc: Sets or clears bit 0x80000 of soldier +0x284 (AI flags); meaning of the bit not identified (Mission3 truck sequence toggles it).

0x0DC.name: respawn_unit
0x0DC.desc: Respawns/resets the object (vtable +0x40; debug print "Respawning unit:%d") and marks it active in the zone object table. Very common in mission scripts.

0x0E0.name: set_team
0x0E0.desc: Changes the object's team (FUN_004c9ea0); a soldier moved to team 0 gets AI flag 0x400000 and the squad-to-player mapping is redone (e.g. the Emir joining).

0x0E8.name: get_object_pointer
0x0E8.desc: Returns the game object for a script id (FUN_004ca660 on [0x63C9A0]). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x0EC.name: get_object_pointer_alt
0x0EC.desc: Identical to 0xE8: game object by script id (FUN_004ca660). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x0F0.name: get_object_position
0x0F0.desc: Copies the object's current world position (render instance) into out and returns out.

0x0F4.name: get_object_base_position
0x0F4.desc: Copies object +0x1FC (a second stored position; for soldiers one of the position copies, possibly the start/home spot) into out and returns out. Mission1 uses it where a table entry is an object id instead of a waypoint.

0x0F8.name: is_path_finished
0x0F8.desc: 1 if the unit has no current waypoint (+0x220 == -1), i.e. it reached the end of its waypoint path.

0x0FC.name: kill_object
0x0FC.desc: Kills/destroys a living object by dealing more damage than its health (soldier vtable +0x3C, vehicle/prop damage); killer = -1 for none.

0x100.name: is_dead
0x100.desc: 1 if the object is dead/destroyed (soldier class query 3, others health == 0) or the id does not exist.

0x104.name: is_dead_and_removed
0x104.desc: 1 if the id does not exist, or the object is out of play (+0xC bit 0 clear) and dead: vehicles/type 0 with health +0x54 == 0, soldiers/type 1 with class query vtable+0x4C(3); 0 for other types or anything in play. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x108.name: is_down
0x108.desc: Units: vtable +0x44 state query; type-8 objects (training targets): +0x54 bit 2. Training scripts use it to check a shot target; probably 'knocked down / hit'.

0x10C.name: get_current_waypoint
0x10C.desc: Returns the waypoint the unit is walking to (+0x220).

0x110.name: set_path
0x110.desc: Starts the unit on the waypoint path beginning at `waypoint` (vtable +0x34); -1 clears it. Usually followed by set_ai_state.

0x114.name: set_ai_state
0x114.desc: Sets the unit's AI state (+0x2378, FUN_0049d870; 5/6 = combat states) and for 0/1 also the sub-state; for vehicles state 0 sets +0x2610.

0x118.name: get_ai_state
0x118.desc: Returns the unit's AI state (+0x2378), e.g. compared with 5.

0x11C.name: set_attack_target
0x11C.desc: Gives the unit a target object (+0x234, with the time at +0x2FC; ignored for same-team targets); 0/unknown target clears it.

0x120.name: set_follow_leader
0x120.desc: Links the follower to a leader object (+0x26A4, registers it in the follow list); used for the Emir (Mission2).

0x124.name: clear_follow_leader
0x124.desc: Unlinks the follower (+0x26A4 = 0); a follower in AI state 3/4 is set back to state 2. Mission11B uses it on Franklin before walking him to the nuke.

0x128.name: move_to_position
0x128.desc: Sends a living soldier (health > 0) to a world position (passed inline) via the A* route-to FUN_0045ba60(pos, notify 1 -> message 0x0A on arrival) and sets AI state 4 (FUN_0049d870). Called by Mission1, Mission11b, Mission3, Mission4, Mission6.

0x12C.name: move_to_waypoint
0x12C.desc: Routes a soldier to a waypoint's position (FUN_0045ba60, arrival notify), stores the start time (+0x23C4) and destination (+0x257C) and sets AI state 4. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x130.name: move_straight_to_waypoint
0x130.desc: Walks a soldier straight at a waypoint's position without route search or arrival message (FUN_0045ba10: single-point path in mover +0x3A0, +0x224 = target, sub-state 2) and sets AI state 4. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x134.name: near_waypoint
0x134.desc: 1 if the object is within `distance` (cm, 3-D) of the waypoint.

0x138.name: end_waypoint_wait
0x138.desc: Clears the unit's waypoint wait end time (+0x238 = 0) so it moves on at once.

0x13C.name: waypoint_in_view_cone
0x13C.desc: 1 if the waypoint lies within `degrees` of the object's facing (yaw from FUN_004c9a40; angle test FUN_004cc260 = acos of the flat direction dot product). Called by Mission12a, Mission8.

0x140.name: near_object
0x140.desc: 1 if the two objects are within `distance` (cm, 3-D) of each other.

0x144.name: near_object_or_dead
0x144.desc: 1 if `object` is dead (health <= 0) or within `distance` of `other` (else as near_object).

0x148.name: near_position
0x148.desc: 1 if the object is within distance (cm, 3-D, FUN_004cc210) of a world position given by pointer. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x14C.name: object_in_view_cone
0x14C.desc: 1 if `other` lies within `degrees` of `object`'s facing (FUN_004cc260, no line-of-sight test). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x150.name: forget_targets
0x150.desc: Clears the soldier's target memory (FUN_00407dc0: +0x258 / +0x260 moved to +0x25C / +0x264 and cleared, the 3 tracked-target entries at +0x290 emptied, FUN_00406390(0), soldiers +0x2C44 = 1). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x154.name: play_sound_at_object
0x154.desc: Plays sound id from the object's own bank (obj+0x40) at its position (min distance = radius*0.25) and posts an AI noise event of that radius (FUN_0049cb20, 2000 ms) so nearby soldiers can hear it. Sites use 3000.0 / 300.0.

0x158.name: is_soldier
0x158.desc: 1 if the object exists and is of type 1 (soldier, +4). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x15C.name: object_in_region
0x15C.desc: True if the object's position is inside region n (sphere or box; FUN_004fc600 + FUN_004fc040). 134 sites.

0x160.name: get_health
0x160.desc: Returns the object's health (+0x54) if its vtable+8 check passes, else 0.0. Callers multiply by a constant (percentage).

0x164.name: get_max_health
0x164.desc: Maximum health from the unit stats (FUN_0049c580: unit type 1 -> stats +0x88 +0x24, type 2 -> vehicle def +0x80 +0x24, as u16); 0.0 for unknown ids or objects failing the vtable+8 check. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x168.name: damage_object
0x168.desc: Deals `amount` damage with no attacker through the object's TakeDamage (vtable +0x3C, soldiers FUN_00424200; scaled by the soldier's damage multiplier +0x2B90). Called by Mission12B, Mission2, Training3, mission10.

0x16C.name: set_field_2e0
0x16C.desc: Writes obj+0x2E0 = value (FUN_0049e790, plain setter; meaning unknown). Only Mission1 (0x12E, 0).

0x170.name: reset_detection_range
0x170.desc: Restores +0x2E0 from its default +0x2E4 (FUN_0049e7a0); +0x2E0 is a range (HStat stats +0x30 or the scene value x 100, scaled by alert level in 0x403C10 - probably sight / detection range); undoes set_field_2e0 (0x16C). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x174.name: set_target_visibility_tracking
0x174.desc: Writes soldier +0x2B60, which gates FUN_004a5f80 (soldier update 0x42B508): periodic line-of-sight samples to the current target (+0x255C) via FUN_004035d0 into the 20-entry history +0x2B0C, timed by experience level; meaning of the effect beyond that not identified. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x178.name: can_see
0x178.desc: AI sight test FUN_004035d0(observer, target, 0xE, 1, 0): target within the fog distance (atmosphere +0xC), inside the observer's view cone (90 deg for player-driven, else +0x2E8) and then the visibility checks. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x17C.name: set_idle_look_around
0x17C.desc: Sets/clears soldier +0x284 bit 0x20000 (on by default in the ctor); it gates FUN_0049cf20, the random idle head/aim glances every 2-5 s. Mission7 only.

0x180.name: set_ai_enabled
0x180.desc: enabled=0 sets soldier +0x284 bit 0x40000000, 1 clears it (AI-off flag). FrontEnd turns it off for its actors, Mission1 for the A-10s; the prisoner release turns it back on.

0x184.name: set_ignore_orders
0x184.desc: Sets/clears obj+0xC bit 0x1000 = AI debug text 'IGNORING ORDER CHANGES': FUN_0049d870 refuses AI mode changes while it is set. Mission11B Franklin while walking him to the nuke.

0x188.name: set_never_excluded
0x188.desc: Sets obj+0xC bit 8 = AI debug text 'Never EXCLUDED': the soldier's AI keeps running even when it would normally be culled (far away / off screen). 45 sites.

0x18C.name: clear_never_excluded
0x18C.desc: Clears obj+0xC bit 8 (see 0x188): the soldier may be excluded from AI updates again.

0x190.name: is_tracking_target
0x190.desc: 1 if target is one of the observer's 3 tracked targets (entries at +0x290, stride 0x18; FUN_00407310) - i.e. the AI is aware of it. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x194.name: set_target_scanning_no_refresh
0x194.desc: FUN_0049ea30(on, 0): sets / clears soldier +0x284 bit 0x400 (threat scan gate) like set_target_scanning (0x1A0) but never refreshes the targets. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x198.name: set_ignore_distractions
0x198.desc: Sets/clears soldier +0x284 bit 0x80 = AI debug text 'IGNORING DISTRACTIONS!' (no reaction to noises / threats; damage-reaction code skips it). For a soldier (type 1) also refreshes squad state (FUN_00407dc0). 112 sites.

0x19C.name: destroy_object
0x19C.desc: Applies damage = health + 1 to the object (FUN_0041a3f0): kills / destroys it through the normal destruction path (messages, effects).

0x1A0.name: set_target_scanning
0x1A0.desc: Sets (on=1) / clears soldier +0x284 bit 0x400, which gates the threat/target scan FUN_00407550; refresh != 0 also calls FUN_00407dc0. Mission1 turns it off for captive Foley (0x1F, 0, 1) and on again on release.

0x1A4.name: set_health_fraction
0x1A4.desc: Sets health (+0x54) = max health (unit stats +0x88 +0x24) * fraction. Mission1: Foley 0.25.

0x1A8.name: is_moving_forward
0x1A8.desc: True if the soldier's movement state (+0x2674) is walking/running/kneel-walking/crawling forwards (states 7-0xC, 0x13, 0x14, 0x53). Training1 'Move forwards'.

0x1AC.name: is_moving_backward
0x1AC.desc: True if the movement state is a backwards one (0xD, 0xE, 0x15, 0x16, 0x54, 0x57, 0x58). Training1 'Move backwards'.

0x1B0.name: is_strafing_a
0x1B0.desc: True if +0x284 has bits 0x2000 and 0x4000 (strafing; 0x4000 probably the direction, left or right unknown). Training1 'Strafe left and right' checks 0x1B0 and 0x1B4.

0x1B4.name: is_strafing_b
0x1B4.desc: True if +0x284 has bit 0x2000 but not 0x4000 (strafing the other direction). Training1 strafe step.

0x1B8.name: is_turning_left
0x1B8.desc: True if the movement state is a turning-left state (5, 0x11, 0x51). Training1 'Turn left and right'.

0x1BC.name: is_turning_right
0x1BC.desc: True if the movement state is a turning-right state (6, 0x12, 0x52).

0x1C0.name: is_crouching
0x1C0.desc: True if stance +0x348 is 1 or 5 (crouched). Training1 'To crouch'.

0x1C4.name: is_standing
0x1C4.desc: True if stance +0x348 is 2 or 3 (standing). Training1's 'To stand back up' prompt goes with this check.

0x1C8.name: is_prone
0x1C8.desc: True if stance +0x348 == 0 (prone). Training1's 'To go prone' prompt goes with this check.

0x1CC.name: is_dead
0x1CC.desc: FUN_0042b160: health <= 0 (for an in-play object of a non-player team only once +0x2A08 + 180 s has passed). 54 sites, 'test eax; je'.

0x1D0.name: set_idle_chatter
0x1D0.desc: Sets / clears soldier +0x284 bit 0x800, required by the chatter gate FUN_004272e0 (0x427325) for random idle speech when the soldier has no target and is below alert 3. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x1D4.name: has_ammo
0x1D4.desc: FUN_00408b10: 1 if any of the 25 inventory items (+0x26B8) is a firing weapon (FUN_004a4c10) with rounds left (magazine +0x80 + reserve +0x54 > 0). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x1D8.name: set_targetable
0x1D8.desc: 1 clears soldier +0x284 bit 0x200, 0 sets it = AI debug text 'Cannot be targetted' (enemies ignore him). Captives are made untargetable; release passes 1.

0x1DC.name: set_stick_to_waypoints
0x1DC.desc: Sets/clears obj+0xC bit 0x10 = AI debug text '** sticking to waypoints **': the soldier keeps to its waypoint path instead of chasing / taking cover.

0x1E0.name: set_ai_flag_10000
0x1E0.desc: Sets soldier +0x284 bit 0x10000 (no clear variant); no reader of the bit was found in the exe. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x1E4.name: set_min_alert_level
0x1E4.desc: FUN_0049d250: alert floor +0x2DC = level (0-4) and raises the current alert +0x2D8 to it. 4 = combat (sends script message 0x04 for enemies).

0x1E8.name: set_alert_level
0x1E8.desc: FUN_0049d2b0: current alert +0x2D8 = level (not below the floor); level 4 on an enemy sends message 0x04 'reached combat alert'.

0x1EC.name: get_alert_level
0x1EC.desc: Returns alert level +0x2D8 (0-4; Mission3 compares with 4 = combat).

0x1F0.name: raise_alert_level
0x1F0.desc: FUN_0049d370: alert +0x2D8 += 1 (max 4), time stamped at +0x304. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x1F4.name: lower_alert_level
0x1F4.desc: FUN_0049d3a0: alert +0x2D8 -= 1 unless at the floor +0x2DC, time stamped at +0x300. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x1F8.name: set_ai_flag_20
0x1F8.desc: Sets soldier +0x284 bit 0x20 (class query vtable+0x4C(0xC) returns it; read in target selection 0x404423 and weapon code 0x4A554D - possibly 'hold fire'). No clear call. Mission1 (0xC), Mission3 guards 0xF3-0xF6.

0x1FC.name: set_time_2a10
0x1FC.desc: Writes soldier +0x2A10 (the timestamp stamp_time_2a10 0x25C sets to now; read at 0x427619, where now < +0x2A10 + 5000 ms suppresses something - e.g. 0 clears it). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x200.name: set_movement_locked
0x200.desc: Sets/clears soldier +0x284 bit 0x4000000; while set the movement code (0x426ADE, 0x45C1F8) ignores the player block's stick input. Training1/3 on the player soldier.

0x204.name: stop_moving
0x204.desc: Clears +0x2394 and applies movement rules MSR_AI_STOP_MOVING (0x1D) and MSR_ZERO_SPEED (3): the soldier halts.

0x208.name: set_stance_stand_walk
0x208.desc: FUN_0045cf00(2, 1) + default stance +0x380 = 2 (standing; the AI itself uses 2 near its destination - walk pace).

0x20C.name: set_stance_stand
0x20C.desc: FUN_0045cf00(3, 1) + default stance +0x380 = 3 (standing, the AI's normal/run stance). 167 sites.

0x214.name: set_stance_crouch_alt
0x214.desc: FUN_0045cf00(5, 1) + default stance +0x380 = 5 (crouched variant, also counted as crouching by 0x1C0).

0x21C.name: set_can_pursue
0x21C.desc: vtable+0x78 = sets/clears soldier +0x284 bit 0x100 (getter vtable+0x7C); without it the AI won't advance on its target (FUN_0049df90 holds, mode 6). Mission1 Foley 0 while captive, 1 after.

0x220.name: stub_0x220
0x220.desc: No-op on PC (bare ret). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x224.name: stub_0x224
0x224.desc: No-op on PC (bare ret). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x228.name: face_waypoint
0x228.desc: Turns the soldier to face waypoint n (waypoint list [0x63C9B0], 0x20-byte entries; angle FUN_004BB100 -> facing target +0x374).

0x22C.name: turn_by
0x22C.desc: Sets the facing target +0x374 to the current rotation (+0x208) with yaw + degrees (wrapped 0-360). Mission3: 180.0.

0x230.name: award_experience
0x230.desc: Awards experience points to a soldier through FUN_00434190 (scaled by difficulty: Easy x0.9, Hard x1.1; can promote up to level 9). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x234.name: set_experience_level
0x234.desc: Sets experience/rank level +0x2A18 clamped 0-9 (FUN_0042d1b0; 'Experience level' in AI debug).

0x238.name: raise_experience_level
0x238.desc: Sets the experience level to level only if the current one (FUN_0042d150) is lower.

0x23C.name: get_experience_level
0x23C.desc: Current experience level (FUN_0042d150: +0x2A18, plus a bonus for player-driven soldiers, max 9); 0 for unknown ids. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x240.name: can_press_switch
0x240.desc: 1 if movement rule 43 MSR_PRESS_SWITCH has a transition from the soldier's current movement state (+0x2674) in the rule table [0x60EC80] (table +8, row width = state count +4). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x244.name: pick_lock_at_waypoint
0x244.desc: Applies movement rule 0x4C MSR_PICK_LOCK (FUN_00433650 -> vtable+0x70) and, if allowed, lines the soldier up on the waypoint's position and rotation (FUN_00433330, 100 cm) - a scripted lock-pick animation at a spot. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x248.name: get_damage_multiplier
0x248.desc: Returns soldier +0x2B90, the factor TakeDamage multiplies incoming damage by (0x42428F; set per squad role at spawn: 1.0 / 1.5 / 0.7); 0.0 for unknown ids. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x24C.name: mount_vehicle
0x24C.desc: Finds a free seat (FUN_0043cfd0) and mounts the soldier into the vehicle (FUN_00433f00). Mission1 (4, 0x71).

0x250.name: is_in_vehicle
0x250.desc: True if the soldier's current vehicle (+0x267C) has script id vehicle.

0x254.name: get_user_of
0x254.desc: vtable+0xA0 (soldier class: +0x26A4) -> script id of the linked object (e.g. who is using a vehicle / mounted gun), -1 if none. Training3 compares with the player (0x79) or -1.

0x258.name: set_skin_texture
0x258.desc: Registers the texture (FUN_0054a0b0) and makes it the render instance's skin override (FUN_00503290); flag 1 also stops all animations of the instance (FUN_00502bb0, caged prisoners). E.g. 'AlliedPOW.bmp'.

0x25C.name: stamp_time_2a10
0x25C.desc: If class query vtable+0x4C(0x11) is true, writes the current game time (ms) to +0x2A10. Training1 30 sites before waits; meaning unknown.

0x260.name: set_calm
0x260.desc: Sets soldier +0x284 bit 0x400000 ('calm': quiet speech) and +0x2A00 = 0. Training3 per soldier.

0x264.name: wave_on
0x264.desc: Movement rule MSR_WAVE_ON (0x5C): the soldier plays the wave-on gesture.

0x26C.name: salute
0x26C.desc: Movement rule 0x5D MSR_SALUTE (vtable+0x70): the soldier salutes. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x274.name: cower
0x274.desc: Movement rule MSR_COWER (0x5E); if it applies, plays sound 0x143 from the soldier's bank (radius 1000).

0x27C.name: stretch
0x27C.desc: Movement rule MSR_STRETCH (0x6A), idle stretch animation.

0x288.name: disembark_vehicle
0x288.desc: Movement rule MSR_DISEMBARK_VEHICLE_LEFT (0x68) if nonzero, else _RIGHT (0x69).

0x28C.name: start_defusing_nuke
0x28C.desc: Movement rule MSR_DEFUSE_NUKE (0x61) + AI mode 0xE (FUN_0049d870). Mission11B Franklin.

0x294.name: reset_soldier_state
0x294.desc: Calls soldier vtable+0x70(0x5F) then re-applies its movement state (+0x2674) via FUN_0042d3a0(state, 0); exact effect unclear (Mission6 only).

0x298.name: freeze_animations
0x298.desc: Switches off every animation layer of the object's render instance (FUN_00502bb0); nothing restarts them (Mission 1 caged Foley).

0x29C.name: stop_spine_anim_layers
0x29C.desc: Switches off the animation layers on the 'BIP01 SPINE1 / SPINE2 CONNECTOR' bones (upper-body layers).

0x2A0.name: stop_hat_anim_layer
0x2A0.desc: Switches off the animation layer on the 'BIP01 HAT CONNECTOR' bone (head layer).

0x2A4.name: stop_face_anim_layer
0x2A4.desc: Switches off the animation layer on the 'BIP01 FACE CONNECTOR' bone.

0x2A8.name: strip_inventory
0x2A8.desc: Removes the soldier's inventory items (FUN_00431830(0); category-8 / special items kept).

0x2AC.name: vehicle_fire_at
0x2AC.desc: Orders a vehicle to fire weapon slot n (+0x260C list) at the target object once: sets +0x2640 target, +0x2644 slot (same as the debug key 'Fire vehicle weapon').

0x2B0.name: set_ai_flag_100000
0x2B0.desc: 0x487840: sets / clears bit 0x100000 of the object's flags +0x284 (every vehicle has it; MP DLLs clear it on the per-faction vehicles 0x16 / 0x3E / 0x19 / 0x18 / 0x3F / 0x1A at start). Exact meaning not identified - see set_ai_flag_200000 (+0x2B4).

0x2B4.name: set_ai_flag_200000
0x2B4.desc: Sets / clears bit 0x200000 of the soldier's AI flags (+0x284). Meaning of the bit not identified.

0x2B8.name: set_ai_flag_200000_all
0x2B8.desc: Sets / clears AI flag bit 0x200000 (+0x284) on every soldier of all 4 teams, except units of class 0xB.

0x2BC.name: damage_team_in_region
0x2BC.desc: Damages every soldier of the team standing in the region by damage_per_second x frame dt (vtable+0x3C); called per frame for kill zones.

0x2C0.name: show_object
0x2C0.desc: Clears render-instance flag 0x10000000 (+0x2C -> +0xC) = object drawn again (Mission 1 init uses it on zone pieces).

0x2C4.name: hide_object
0x2C4.desc: Sets render-instance flag 0x10000000 (+0x2C -> +0xC) = object not drawn.

0x2C8.name: set_render_position
0x2C8.desc: Calls the render instance's vtable[0](position, 0) (object +0x2C) = moves the drawn model to a world position; the game object / physics position is not changed (game code pairs it with FUN_004c9a00). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x2CC.name: fire_weapon
0x2CC.desc: Pulls the trigger of a weapon object once with itself as shooter (FUN_004a1ad0(weapon, weapon, 0, 0, 0)) - for weapons placed in the world. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x2D0.name: fire_weapon_at_position
0x2D0.desc: Turns a weapon object to face the position (FUN_004a4e80, angle FUN_004bb100) and fires it once (FUN_004a1ad0). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x2D4.name: fire_weapon_at_object
0x2D4.desc: fire_weapon_at_position (0x2D0) at the target object's current position. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x2D8.name: call_strike
0x2D8.desc: Queues a timed strike at a position (one of 10 slots of [0x60EDA4], 8000 ms, posts event 0x6F; target -1 = none); network MP sends it via FUN_004636f0. Probably the air / mortar strike (Training2 air-strike lesson).

0x2DC.name: give_magazines
0x2DC.desc: Adds magazines x magazine size (def +0x92) to a weapon item's reserve rounds (skipped in grenade-launcher mode).

0x2E0.name: weapon_is_empty
0x2E0.desc: 1 when the item (or a soldier's held weapon) has no rounds left (magazine +0x80 + reserve +0x54 = 0).

0x2E4.name: clear_weapon_state
0x2E4.desc: Zeroes weapon item fields +0x74, +0x84, +0x88 (fire / reload timers?); Training1 only.

0x2E8.name: get_env_sound_position
0x2E8.desc: Copies the position of environment (ENVSND) sound slot n (sound manager [0x63C9AC] +0x54 + n*0x34) into out and returns out (hidden struct-return argument first). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x2EC.name: enable_env_sound
0x2EC.desc: Turns an environment (ENVSND) sound slot on, restoring its volume (sound manager slot, stride 0x34).

0x2F0.name: disable_env_sound
0x2F0.desc: Turns an environment (ENVSND) sound slot off.

0x2F4.name: set_env_sound_volume
0x2F4.desc: Sets an enabled environment sound slot's volume (0..1, e.g. 0.05, 1.0).

0x2F8.name: play_sound
0x2F8.desc: Plays a sound id from a sound bank, non-positional (2D), min distance 1000.

0x2FC.name: play_sound_at
0x2FC.desc: Plays a sound id from a bank at a world position (x, y, z passed inline), min distance 1000.

0x300.name: clear_sound_queue
0x300.desc: Empties the scripted sound / speech sequence queue (count [0x617C50] = 0).

0x304.name: queue_sound
0x304.desc: Appends a sound to the sequence queue (max 12); position used when positional = 1, speaker -1 = none.

0x308.name: play_sound_queue
0x308.desc: Starts the queued sound sequence (FUN_0055de90); 1 when the queue was not empty.

0x30C.name: debug_print
0x30C.desc: Debug text output; a no-op in the shipped exe (jumps to the debug-mappings getter).

0x310.name: hide_info_bar
0x310.desc: Sets info-bar object [0x63C988] +0x48; non-zero stops the render loop drawing the top info bar (item names / pick-ups, FUN_00507b30 at 0x40F222). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x314.name: key_active
0x314.desc: 1 while a keyboard key (DirectInput scan code) has any non-zero state in the key table 0x753940 (jmp FUN_00539da0); 0 for the 'none' code 0x1146 or while [0x754C6C] is set. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x318.name: key_down
0x318.desc: 1 while a keyboard key (DirectInput scan code, 2..9 = keys 1..8) is down; scripts use it for debug shortcuts behind debug_mode_enabled.

0x31C.name: key_released
0x31C.desc: 1 when a key's state in 0x753940 is 3 or 4 (released this frame) (jmp FUN_00539e10); note it also returns 1 for the 'none' code 0x1146. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x320.name: player1_action_pressed
0x320.desc: Bit 1 of player 1's input-block action flags (block 0x60F5B8 +0x84 + action*4, byte at 0x60F63C+action*4): the action's 'pressed' bit (action ids = the default.key action table 0x5EC2B8). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x324.name: set_camera_target_object
0x324.desc: Sets scripted camera n's target (camera manager [0x63C9D8], camera +8+n*0x1D8, field +0xE4 via FUN_004d4ed0) to the object's render instance (obj+0x2C) - for CAMTARGOBJ / chase cameras. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x328.name: set_player_soldier
0x328.desc: Hands an active object to every player's view controller (FUN_00472cb0): camera / control switch to it.

0x32C.name: camera_shake
0x32C.desc: Starts a camera shake on every viewport camera (e.g. 25.0, 0, 2000.0); ignored while one is running.

0x330.name: pause_zone_tracking
0x330.desc: While set, (de)activations don't update the per-zone rosters ([0x617DD0]); scripts wrap their zone streaming in 1 ... 0.

0x334.name: zone_of_object
0x334.desc: World zone index of the object's model (+0x1C -> +0xC8 -> +0x1BC); -1 if none.

0x338.name: get_zone_objects
0x338.desc: Returns the zone's roster: pointer to {object id, enabled} pairs and their count (0 for a bad index).

0x33C.name: count_zone_active
0x33C.desc: Number of the zone's roster objects currently in play (object +0xC bit 0).

0x340.name: count_zone_enabled
0x340.desc: Number of the zone's roster objects marked enabled (the scripts' 'grunts' count).

0x344.name: restore_zone_objects
0x344.desc: For each {id, enabled} roster entry: enabled -> activate (soldiers resumed), else deactivate. Used when a player enters a zone.

0x348.name: suspend_zone_objects
0x348.desc: Records each roster object's in-play state, then deactivates it. Used when no player is in the zone.

0x34C.name: zone_activate_one
0x34C.desc: Keeps one roster object active in the player soldier's zone: drops *current if it left / died, else picks an enabled, idle, living one (FUN_00484640) and activates it; *current = its id or -1.

0x350.name: zone_grunt_alive
0x350.desc: 1 if any enabled zone-roster entry ([0x617DA8], via get_zone_objects 0x482340) is not dead (is_dead 0x483B20); with include_mounted = 0 only soldiers not in a vehicle (+0x267C = 0) count. Bool twin of count_living_grunts (+0x354). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x354.name: count_living_grunts
0x354.desc: Counts enabled, living roster objects in all zones; with 0 only those whose +0x267C is 0.

0x358.name: init_spawn_points
0x358.desc: Allocates count spawn points (0x1C bytes, all off), max spawned = 9, spawning on; param2 stored at [0x617DC8]. Returns 1.

0x35C.name: set_max_spawned
0x35C.desc: Sets the spawn system's maximum ([0x617DC0], default 9) - the scripts' 'capacity'.

0x368.name: set_spawn_flag_617dd4
0x368.desc: Sets spawn-system flag [0x617DD4] (1 after init_spawn_points); meaning unclear.

0x36C.name: set_spawn_query
0x36C.desc: Sets [0x617DC8] (also set by init_spawn_points' 2nd arg): when non-zero the spawn system asks the script with message 0x49 (spawn veto, param = spawn index) before each spawn (0x482D21). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x370.name: setup_spawn_point
0x370.desc: Fills spawn record index ([0x618340], 0x1C bytes) if index < count [0x618344]: +0/+4/+8 position (cm), +0xC threshold compared against the spawner's level argument (record used only when <= it), +0x18 roster zone (-1 any; checked against the zone of the object, 0x482190), +0x14 spawns left (-1 unlimited, decremented per spawn), +0x10 state = 1 (on). The nearest eligible point to the requester is used. Called by Mission1, Mission11a, Mission11b, Mission12B, Mission12a, Mission2, Mission3, Mission4, Mission5B, Mission5a, Mission6, Mission7, Mission8, Mission9, mission10.

0x374.name: get_spawn_point
0x374.desc: Pointer to a spawn point record (0x1C bytes: +0x10 state 0 off / 1 on / 2 permanently off, +0x14 counter). Scripts read / bump the fields directly.

0x378.name: enable_spawn_point
0x378.desc: Turns the spawn point on (state 1); a permanently disabled one only with force (logs 'Enabling spawn point').

0x37C.name: disable_spawn_point
0x37C.desc: Turns the spawn point off (state 0) or permanently off (state 2); no effect on a permanently disabled one.

0x384.name: spawn_pending
0x384.desc: 1 if any enabled spawn point has a non-zero counter (+0x14).

0x388.name: reset_view_controllers
0x388.desc: Sets field +0x2AC = 0 on the 4 per-player view controllers ([0x63C990..0x63C99C]); Training1 only.

0x38C.name: set_min_soldier_level
0x38C.desc: Raises every soldier (all teams) whose experience level (+0x2DC) is below level to it (FUN_0049d250).

0x390.name: debug_mode_enabled
0x390.desc: Debug key-mappings toggle ([0x60F560]); scripts guard debug prints / keys with it. 0 in normal play.

0x394.name: query_0x394
0x394.desc: Always returns 1 in the PC exe (stub); Mission1 skips a block when 1.

0x398.name: query_0x398
0x398.desc: Always returns 0 in the PC exe (stub; console / MP leftover?).

0x39C.name: campaign_flag_zero
0x39C.desc: 1 when the campaign object's first field ([[0x60EDC0]+0]) is 0; meaning unclear.

0x3A0.name: is_invulnerable_cheat
0x3A0.desc: Returns the INVULNERABLE cheat flag [0x5E640C] (saved as save-header flag 1), or 1 during a cinematic in network MP ([0x610F60]) (jmp FUN_00402fb0). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x3A4.name: is_difficulty_easy
0x3A4.desc: 1 when the difficulty (FUN_004f0070 on [0x63C9E0]) is 0 (EASY). With DesertStormFix 3.2+ also for its VERY EASY (level 4); game.difficulty() tells them apart.

0x3A8.name: is_difficulty_hard
0x3A8.desc: 1 when the difficulty is 2 (HARD). With DesertStormFix 3.2+ also for its VERY HARD (level 3); game.difficulty() tells them apart.

0x3AC.name: point_in_region
0x3AC.desc: Whether a world position lies inside the region (region manager [0x63C9B8]).

0x3B0.name: player_in_region
0x3B0.desc: Whether the first player's soldier (first input block with a soldier) is inside the region.

0x3B4.name: player_near_object
0x3B4.desc: Whether the first player's soldier is within radius (cm) of the object.

0x3B8.name: player_near_point
0x3B8.desc: True if the first player who has a soldier is within radius (cm) of the point (exe 0x4CC210 distance test). Mission1 uses radius 1000.0.

0x3BC.name: get_player_soldier
0x3BC.desc: Script id of the soldier the player controls (input block +0x310 -> obj+8), -1 if none.

0x3C0.name: get_player_target
0x3C0.desc: Script id of the object currently targeted / under the player's crosshair (input block +0x3AC, read by the crosshair code), -1 if none. Training1 compares it with the shooting targets.

0x3C4.name: get_player_zone
0x3C4.desc: Zone id the player's soldier is in (soldier+0x1C -> +0xC8 -> +0x1BC); Mission3 prints it as 'Zone ID:%d'. 0 if no soldier.

0x3C8.name: is_player_controlled
0x3C8.desc: True if the object is a soldier currently driven by a player (type 1 and soldier+0x23C0 input block set).

0x3CC.name: object_zone_id
0x3CC.desc: World zone index of the object's model (obj+0x1C -> +0xC8 -> +0x1BC); 0 if the id doesn't exist. Same as zone_of_object (+0x334) except the missing-object result. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x3D0.name: squad_in_region
0x3D0.desc: True if any member of the player team (active list of team [0x5F9B94]) stands inside the region (region list [0x63C9B8]).

0x3D4.name: kill_units_in_region
0x3D4.desc: Every soldier (object list kind 1) of teams 1-3 whose position (render instance +0xF4 or FUN_004cd890) is inside the region (FUN_004fc040, region manager [0x63C9B8]) is killed via kill_object(id, -1) (0x483A10). Team 0 (the squad) is spared. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x3D8.name: stub_3d8
0x3D8.desc: For a soldier (type 1) tail-calls FUN_00421420, which is a bare ret - no-op on PC. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x3DC.name: squad_in_zone
0x3DC.desc: True if any member of the player team is in the given zone id (same zone lookup as get_player_zone).

0x3E0.name: teleport_player_to_point
0x3E0.desc: Moves the current player's soldier ([0x60F394] block, block+0x310) to the position (FUN_0049ce70(pos,1,1,800.0,0)), re-attaches its view controller (FUN_00472cb0), resets its target tracking (FUN_00407dc0) and flashes the screen blue (1500 ms, 64,64,255). Position-pointer twin of teleport_player_to_waypoint (+0x3E4). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x3E4.name: teleport_player_to_waypoint
0x3E4.desc: Moves the current player's soldier to the waypoint position (waypoint manager [0x63C9B0]), re-attaches the camera and fades the view in over 1500 ms.

0x3E8.name: move_region_contents
0x3E8.desc: Teleports every object of teams 0-3 (lists 1 = soldiers not in a vehicle, 5 and 6) standing inside from_region by the offset between the two regions' centres (region +0x14..+0x1C) (FUN_004c9f20(pos,1,1,800.0,0)); if player 1's soldier moved, his view is re-attached (FUN_00472cb0). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x3F0.name: get_loading_save_state
0x3F0.desc: Raw value of the 'level is being loaded from a save' field ([0x60EDC4]+0xA4); scripts treat non-zero as loading a save.

0x3F4.name: is_loading_save
0x3F4.desc: True while the level is being started from a saved game ([0x60EDC4]+0xA4 != 0); scripts then skip intros and set their state to 'in game'.

0x3F8.name: team_none_downed
0x3F8.desc: True unless some team member is down (health <= 0) but not yet finally dead (class query 3). Mission1 checks it for team 0 before ending the mission at the extraction.

0x3FC.name: team_near_point
0x3FC.desc: 1 if any active soldier (list kind 1) of the team is within radius (cm) of the point (distance test FUN_004cc210). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x400.name: set_team_alert_level
0x400.desc: Sets the AI alert level (soldier +0x2DC, raises +0x2D8) of every member of the team, active and inactive lists; hostile soldiers are kept at >= 3. Seen with 3 and 4.

0x404.name: set_team_ai_flag_80
0x404.desc: Sets / clears AI flag 0x80 in soldier +0x284 for every member of the team (players' soldiers also refreshed). Meaning of the flag unknown; used in the Training levels.

0x408.name: set_teams_not_hostile
0x408.desc: Clears both entries of the team relationship matrix 0x640480[a][b] / [b][a] (non-zero = hostile). Mission1 uses (0,2),(1,2) at the extraction.

0x40C.name: set_teams_hostile
0x40C.desc: 0x481E60: sets both entries of the team relationship matrix 0x640480[a][b] / [b][a] to 1 (hostile); counterpart of +0x408.

0x410.name: get_team_skill_level
0x410.desc: Average skill / trooper level (0-9, soldier +0x2A18 incl. rank bonus) of the team's non-captive members, rounded, capped at 9.

0x414.name: award_team_experience
0x414.desc: Calls the experience award FUN_00434190(points) (difficulty-scaled) on every member of the team, active (FUN_004c9720) and inactive (FUN_004c96d0) lists. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x418.name: raise_team_skill_level
0x418.desc: For every team member (active + inactive lists): skill level = current level (FUN_0042d150, incl. rank bonus) + (delta & 0xFF), stored via FUN_0042d1b0 (soldier +0x2A18 clamped 0-9, accuracy from table 0x619428). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x41C.name: set_team_skill_level
0x41C.desc: Sets the skill / trooper level (0-9, soldier +0x2A18, accuracy from table 0x619428) of every member of the team. Every mission calls it at the start with 'squad level - 3 / 2 / 1' for Easy / Medium / Hard; DesertStormFix 3.2+ adds 1 on VERY HARD and takes 1 off on VERY EASY.

0x420.name: team_has_members
0x420.desc: True if the team's active object list is not empty.

0x424.name: is_player_aiming
0x424.desc: True if player 1 is in aim mode (player +8 == 2). Training tutorial check.

0x428.name: is_player_fire_mode_burst
0x428.desc: True if player 1's held weapon (type 6) is in fire mode 2 (burst). Training tutorial check.

0x42C.name: set_fire_mode_grenade_launcher
0x42C.desc: Switches the soldier's held weapon (vtable +0x74, item type 6) to fire mode 0x100 (M203 grenade launcher) via FUN_004a4fb0(0x100, 0). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x430.name: set_fire_mode_burst
0x430.desc: Switches the soldier's held weapon (vtable +0x74, item type 6) to fire mode 2 (burst) via FUN_004a4fb0(2, 0). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x434.name: find_object_roster_zone
0x434.desc: Index of the zone roster ([0x617DA8]: +0 array of per-zone id lists, +4 count) that contains the script id, -1 if none (FUN_00482190; the spawn system uses it for spawn-point zones). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x438.name: is_door_closed
0x438.desc: True if the door's open flag (object +0x54 bit 1) is clear.

0x43C.name: set_door_open
0x43C.desc: Opens (non-zero) or closes (0.0) a door object (type 7) unless it is locked / busy (+0x54 bit 0); sends script message 0x15. Mission1 passes 1.0.

0x440.name: set_door_flags
0x440.desc: Door object (type 7) flags +0x54 = (flags & ~mask) | value. Mission1 clears bit 8 on several doors.

0x444.name: add_door_route_link

0x448.desc: Sets the up/down (open) state of a non-door object class with +0x54 state bits (bit 1 state, bit 0 changing, time +0x88); non-zero raises. Training1 uses it on the shooting targets 0x85/0x86.

0x44C.name: set_object_flags_54
0x44C.desc: Object +0x54 = (flags & ~mask) | value with no type check (door / target state bits: bit 0 busy/locked, bit 1 open/raised). Unchecked twin of set_door_flags (+0x440). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x450.name: set_switch_state
0x450.desc: Switch by index (manager [0x63C9C4], 100-byte entries, FUN_004f6970) -> FUN_004f71c0(state): 0 sets entry +0x10 bit 1 (and clears bit 0) and swaps the on/off models; non-zero clears bits 0-1 and swaps back. 0x458.name: face_each_other

0x460.name: set_pause_allowed

0x464.desc: Object manager [0x63C9A0] +0x34: highest valid script id in the id table (+0x30) (lookups check id <= it). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x494.name: set_mission_index
0x494.desc: Campaign +0: current mission number (Mission11A 11, 11B 12, 12B 14, front end 15).

0x498.name: set_mission_texts
0x498.desc: Stores two catalog text hashes in campaign +8 / +0xC (mission name texts, set during init next to the briefing).

0x49C.name: request_main_menu

0x4A0.name: add_mission_points

0x4D0.desc: Writes 1/0 to *shown (flag 2) and *done (flag 4) of the objective; nothing written if the index is invalid. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x4D4.desc: Adds a map marker at a fixed position to the objective (first free of 12 slots).

0x4D8.desc: Clears the objective's marker slot n (0-11).

0x4DC.name: remove_objective_marker_at
0x4DC.desc: Removes the objective marker whose position equals the given point.

0x4E0.name: set_briefing_text
0x4E0.desc: Briefing text: slot 0 title, 1 date, 2 place, 3+ next story page.

0x4E4.desc: vsprintf into a 1 KB buffer and appends it to the debug text buffer 0x757140 (debug output).

0x4E8.desc: Debug: draws the script ids of all team 0-3 units on screen (the player's marked '<<') plus a counter.

0x4EC.name: get_object_pointer_alias
0x4EC.desc: Raw object pointer for a script id (FUN_004ca610 on [0x63C9A0], range-checked; 0 for -1 / out of range). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x4F0.name: cycle_view_to_next_unit
0x4F0.desc: Debug: steps a global index to the next suitable object and makes every player's view follow it.

0x4F4.name: stop_all_cameras
0x4F4.desc: Stops all 128 scripted cameras and resets view 0 to the game camera.

0x4F8.desc: Restarts scripted camera n by its type (camera manager [0x63C9D8], FUN_004d4ac0: 0 free / 1 target pos / 2 target obj / 3 chase): eye back to its start (+0x5C) and path progress cleared. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x4FC.name: set_view_camera
0x4FC.desc: Makes camera n the active camera of view 0 (0 = back to the player camera), resets the view controller; non-zero also starts a timer ramp (1.0, 5.0).

0x500.name: is_game_camera_active
0x500.desc: True if view 0 has no scripted camera (camera id 0).

0x504.name: set_view_camera_delayed
0x504.desc: Queues an event (flags 0xE) that after delay_ms makes camera n view 0's camera (FUN_004d4f80(n, 0)) and stores it in [0x5ED118]. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x508.name: queue_callback
0x508.desc: Queues a plain timed callback (event queue [0x63C978], FUN_004db6b0, flags 0xE): the DLL function is called with the event after delay_ms. Like queue_call (+0x518) without arguments / skippable flag. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x50C.name: place_at_waypoint
0x50C.desc: Teleports an object (types 0/1/6) to a scene waypoint's position (waypoint table [0x63C9B0], 32-byte entries), keeping the exact height (FUN_0049ce70 -> FUN_004c9f20).

0x510.name: place_at_position
0x510.desc: Teleports an object to a world position (cm) if it is active (vtable+8), exact height kept.

0x514.name: face_waypoint_direction
0x514.desc: Turns the object to the waypoint's stored rotation (waypoint table [0x63C9B0], entry +0xC, FUN_004d1400): soldiers get yaw+180 (wrapped) as wanted facing (FUN_0049e7b0) + FUN_0049d4a0(7); types 0/6 are rotated directly (FUN_004c9a70). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x518.name: queue_call
0x518.desc: Timed callback queue (the cutscene / overview builder). Pushes a type-6 event on the event queue [0x63C978] (FUN_004db6b0): after delay_ms (float, milliseconds from now) the game calls the DLL function callback(event*), which reads arg1 at event+0x34 and arg2 at event+0x38 and calls ONE ordinary API slot with them. Events queued while the cinematic bit is set get flags 0x1E (skippable: +0x560 runs them at once). There are no command codes - the 'command' is whichever API slot the callback wraps; see 'commands' (API slot(s) the callback calls: number of the 2783 queue_call sites).

commands.0x7C0+0x110/0x114: look up object, then move/route it (164; +0x110/+0x114 alone: 52)
commands.0x034: unknown (126; callback is itself a DLL function pointer arg)
commands.0x66C: place at waypoint with its rotation (118)
commands.0x540: fade out to colour (113; arg1 = ms int, arg2 = colour 0xAARRGGBB)
commands.0x53C: fade in from colour (112; arg1 = ms int, arg2 = colour)
commands.0x52C: play scripted animation / back to default (111)
commands.0x560+0x4FC+0x4F4+0x534+0x584+0x51C+0x59: cutscene end chain: run queued calls, camera off, letterbox off, AI on, input on, movie end (30)

0x51C.name: set_player_control
0x51C.desc: Turns player input on/off for every player block (block +0x34); off parks each block's soldier in 0x617C40 and detaches it, on reattaches it. Used around cutscenes.

0x520.name: set_player_input
0x520.desc: For every player block (count [0x610798]): +0x34 = enabled and control mode FUN_004500b0(enabled ? 0 player : 2 AI). Lighter twin of set_player_control (+0x51C) without parking soldiers / cameras. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x524.name: load_animation
0x524.desc: Loads (or finds already loaded) a .prs animation by file name through the anim manager [0x63C968] (FUN_00500a40); returns the handle used by +0x52C / +0x654.

0x528.name: unload_animation
0x528.desc: Removes an animation (as returned by load_animation +0x524) from the anim manager [0x63C968] list and frees it (FUN_00500b30). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x52C.name: play_scripted_animation
0x52C.desc: Plays a loaded animation on a soldier as scripted movement state 0x4B (anim mode 3); anim 0 returns the soldier to the default movement state (the one set by +0x670).

0x530.name: letterbox_on
0x530.desc: Starts the cinematic letterbox bars (view controller [0x63C98C] FUN_004d1d00(1); skipped with dev flag u).

0x538.name: flash_screen
0x538.desc: 0x486190: logs 'flashscreen called at %d' (GetTickCount), then FUN_004D2C30(view controller [0x63C98C], ms, r, g, b) = full-screen colour flash. Not referenced by the six MP DLLs.

0x53C.name: fade_in
0x53C.desc: Screen fade from a solid colour (0-255 per channel) back to the picture over duration_ms (view controller FUN_004d2c70, mode 1). Queued at the start of each cutscene shot.

0x540.name: fade_out
0x540.desc: Screen fade from the picture to a solid colour over duration_ms (FUN_004d2cd0, mode 0); (0, 0,0,0) clears. Queued at the end of each cutscene shot.

0x544.name: take_control
0x544.desc: Makes every player block drive the given soldier (view 0 camera saved in 0x5ED118 and switched, block soldier = object, camera mode 1) - scripted 'player takes control' moments.

0x548.name: release_control
0x548.desc: Undoes +0x544: block soldier cleared, control mode 2 (AI drives), saved camera restored.

0x54C.name: select_item_by_name

0x554.desc: Drops the first inventory item with that definition name to the ground (FUN_00431c70(item, 0)); else error box "GruntDropItem : Grunt hasn't got item %s". Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x558.name: stub_558
0x558.desc: Returns 0 - no-op on PC. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x55C.name: stub_55c
0x55C.desc: Empty function (ret) - no-op on PC. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x560.name: run_queued_calls
0x560.desc: Runs every pending skippable event in the event queue at once (FUN_004db670 on [0x63C978], flag 8) - skips a cutscene built with +0x518.

0x564.name: spawn_effects_in_region
0x564.desc: Queues count particle effects of the given type (effects system [0x63C974], FUN_004f0b10 - the gib/dust spawner) at random points inside the region, spread over duration_ms (>= 200) (FUN_004f1fe0 -> event callback 0x4F1E30). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x568.name: mount_ladder
0x568.desc: Mounts the soldier on the nearest ladder (FUN_00433690 finds it and the end, bottom or top; FUN_00433850 applies MSR_MOUNT_LADDER_BOTTOM 0x3A / _TOP 0x3B and sets the move target to the other end). anywhere = 0: only within reach of the ladder end. Climbing = movement rule MSR_LADDER_CLIMB_UP 0x3C / DOWN 0x3D applied every frame (soldier vtable +0x70); the game dismounts at the end. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x56C.name: dismount_ladder
0x56C.desc: If the soldier is on a ladder (vtable +0x60) calls vtable +0x68: movement rule 0x3E then FUN_004348e0 (gets off the ladder). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x570.name: climb_ladder_up
0x570.desc: If on a ladder (vtable +0x60), sets the AI state FUN_0049d870(9) (+0x2378 = 9, which selects movement mode 9); probably climb up - direction not verified. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x574.name: climb_ladder_down
0x574.desc: If on a ladder (vtable +0x60), sets the AI state FUN_0049d870(10) (movement mode 10); probably climb down - direction not verified. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x578.name: is_on_ladder
0x578.desc: Soldier vtable +0x60 (FUN_00437410): 1 while the movement state +0x2674 is a ladder state (0x38-0x3C, 0x3E, 0x3F). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x57C.name: start_firing

0x580.name: stop_firing
0x580.desc: Releases the trigger of the soldier's held weapon (FUN_004a4a30: weapon +0x64/+0x68 = 0).

0x584.name: resume_ai
0x584.desc: End-of-cutscene resume: sets the AI-enabled bit 0x1000000 (soldier +0x284) on all soldiers via [0x60EDA0] and clears the global no-damage flag 0x60F25C.

0x588.name: freeze_ai
0x588.desc: Cutscene freeze: clears the AI-enabled bit 0x1000000 on all soldiers and sets the global no-damage flag 0x60F25C (counterpart of +0x584).

0x58C.name: movie_cancel_pressed
0x58C.desc: Cutscene skip query: 1 when any player pressed MOVIE_CANCEL (action 0x36), with fade + [0x618348] = 1 as side effect (also 1 with dev flag u).

0x590.name: movie_cancel_held
0x590.desc: Same query as +0x58C without side effects.

0x594.name: movie_start
0x594.desc: Starts a cinematic (sets cinematic bit [0x63C948]+0x1B8C bit 0).

0x598.name: movie_end
0x598.desc: Ends a cinematic; sends script message 0x12 after the overview.

0x59C.name: link_convoy
0x59C.desc: Links vehicles into a convoy chain: vehicle follows 'ahead' and leads 'behind' (-1 = none; +0x2C28/+0x2C2C/+0x2C30), gap in cm (2000/3000 seen). Mission 4 trucks, Mission 8.

0x5A0.name: set_speed
0x5A0.desc: Sets a vehicle/aircraft speed factor: max +0x2C38 and current +0x2C34 (0.25-5 seen).

0x5A4.name: set_timer
0x5A4.desc: Queues a timer event (callback 0x487210, flags 0xE one-shot / 0xB repeating) that sends script message 0x16 (TIMER) with the id after delay_ms; param goes to event +0x14 (0 in practice). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x5AC.desc: Registers a key item for a locked door (table [0x60EDA8], entries {key, door, -1}); using the key unlocks the door (flag 8). Mission 1: cooler keys 0x46 -> 0x25.

0x5B0.name: give_item

0x5B4.name: take_item
0x5B4.desc: Removes an item object from a soldier's inventory (FUN_004318a0).

0x5B8.name: drop_item
0x5B8.desc: Removes the item object from the soldier's inventory and puts it into the world active (FUN_004318a0(item, 1, 0); take_item +0x5B4 passes 0). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x5BC.name: remove_medikits
0x5BC.desc: Sets the soldier's category-8 item (MediKit) count to 0 and holsters it if held.

0x5C0.name: has_item
0x5C0.desc: True when the soldier carries the item object (FUN_00437200).

0x5C4.name: medikit_count
0x5C4.desc: Count of the soldier's category-8 item (MediKit; owner +0x2DA0 / item +0x54).

0x5C8.name: is_holding

0x5F0.desc: Sets render instance flag 0x10000: the frame animation (+0x5EC) stops on its last frame (speed +0xEC cleared) instead of looping (FUN_004cccd0). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x5F8.name: make_invulnerable
0x5F8.desc: Sets the soldier's invulnerable bit 0x800000 (+0x284) - cutscene actors.

0x5FC.name: set_squad_vulnerable
0x5FC.desc: FUN_00403050(1): stores 1 in [0x5E640C] and walks every object (FUN_004ca910, callback 0x402FE0): player-side soldiers get the invulnerable bit 0x800000 (+0x284) cleared. Unused by the shipped DLLs.
