0x610.desc: Clears the soldier's AI-enabled bit 0x1000000 (+0x284); +0x60C sets it.

0x614.name: show_tutorial_text
0x614.desc: Formats a catalog text (printf with the following arguments, e.g. control names from +0x618) into the tutorial/objective bar 0x617DE8; ignored in split screen.

0x618.name: get_control_name
0x618.desc: Returns the text of the keys/buttons bound to a control (index into 0x5D9338 -> action id), for tutorial text.

0x61C.name: show_subtitle
0x61C.desc: When the byte option [0x5ED0DA] is on (initially 1; probably subtitles), looks up a mission text (FUN_004f5e80 on [0x60EDCC]) into [0x6181E8] and shows it for duration_ms (0 = 10000) in the top text box (rect 0x618300, drawn by FUN_00486d20, ends at [0x618310]). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x620.name: stub_620
0x620.desc: Bare ret - no-op on PC. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x624.name: stub_624
0x624.desc: Bare ret - no-op on PC. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x628.name: stub_628
0x628.desc: Bare ret - no-op on PC. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x62C.name: atmosphere_ramp_04
0x62C.desc: 0x487DC0: FUN_004EFDF0 on the atmosphere [[0x63C948]+0x1A58]: ramps field +4 to float(target) over duration (rate +0x2C, end +0x28, time +0x34; duration <= 0 sets it at once). Which value +4 is not identified. Not referenced by the six MP DLLs.

0x630.name: atmosphere_ramp_0c
0x630.desc: 0x487E00: like +0x62C for atmosphere field +0xC (FUN_004EFE30: +0x24 end, +0x30 rate, +0x38 time). Not referenced by the six MP DLLs.

0x634.name: face_object
0x634.desc: Turns a soldier to face another object (head bone for soldiers).

0x638.name: face_position
0x638.desc: Turns a soldier to face a world position.

0x63C.name: attack_target
0x63C.desc: Forces a soldier's AI target (adds it as known enemy, message 0x34) and locks fire on it (+0x2564/+0x2568 = 1).

0x640.name: clear_attack_target
0x640.desc: Releases the forced target / fire lock of +0x63C.

0x644.name: aim_at_target
0x644.desc: Sets a forced target without the fire lock (+0x2568 = 1 only) - soldier aims/tracks.

0x64C.name: enter_nearest_vehicle
0x64C.desc: Finds the vehicle the soldier could enter (enter search FUN_00433ad0), a free seat of the wanted kind (seat finder FUN_0043ce90) and mounts him (FUN_00433f00(vehicle, seat kind, seat, 0)). No null check on the found vehicle. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x650.name: dismount
0x650.desc: Makes a soldier leave the vehicle / mounted gun it is on (+0x267C, FUN_0042e850).

0x654.name: play_animation_mode
0x654.desc: Like +0x52C but anim mode 4 (flag set) or 6 (flag 0) - probably loop vs play-once; anim 0 does nothing.

0x658.name: night_vision_on
0x658.desc: Turns the night-vision view effect on for all views (sound 0x4BE).

0x65C.name: night_vision_off
0x65C.desc: Turns night vision off for all views.

0x664.name: set_reserved_soldiers
0x664.desc: Stores a reserved soldier count (0x6182FC) used by +0x668.

0x668.name: free_soldier_slots
0x668.desc: 16 - reserved (+0x664) - soldiers currently in the object lists: room left for spawning.

0x66C.name: place_at_waypoint_rotated
0x66C.desc: Teleports an object to a waypoint and turns it to the waypoint's stored rotation (cutscene actor placement).

0x670.name: set_default_movement_state
0x670.desc: Sets the default movement state (MovementStateRules table [0x60EC80]) that +0x52C(object, 0) returns soldiers to.

0x674.name: light_on
0x674.desc: Turns a scene light on: sets flag 4 on light entry (index & 0xFF) of the Lights.cpp manager [0x63C95C] (+8 array, 0x108 B each). Lights without flag 4 contribute nothing (0x51E176).

0x678.name: light_off
0x678.desc: Turns a scene light off (clears flag 4 of the light entry in [0x63C95C]). Mission 1 switches lights 0x15/0x14/0x10/0x0D off after its intro film.

0x67C.name: is_light_on
0x67C.desc: Returns flag 4 (on) of light entry (index & 0xFF) in the Lights.cpp manager [0x63C95C] (+8 array, 0x108 B each) - FUN_0051c050; see +0x674 / +0x678. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x680.name: set_light_colours
0x680.desc: FUN_0051d3f0 on [0x63C95C]: sets two colours of a scene light (FUN_0051bd50 / FUN_0051bd30, D3DLIGHT8 at entry +0x34) and, with a fade time and the fader from +0x698, blends over it; else SetLight at once. Which D3D colours (diffuse / ambient) not verified. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x684.name: set_light_ambient
0x684.desc: FUN_0051d2d0: writes the colour into the light's D3DLIGHT8 ambient (entry +0x34 +0x24) and calls IDirect3DDevice8::SetLight at once. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x688.name: set_light_diffuse
0x688.desc: FUN_0051d330: sets the light's diffuse colour (entry +0x34 +4); with a fade time and a fader (+0x698, entry flag 0x40) it blends there over the time, else SetLight at once. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x68C.name: reset_light
0x68C.desc: FUN_0051d720: restores the light's D3DLIGHT8 from its saved original values (entry +0x9C..) and re-applies it. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x690.name: detach_light
0x690.desc: Removes a light index from the object's render instance light list (+0x1A0 count, +0x1A4 bytes; FUN_004d0560) - the object is no longer lit by it. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x694.name: attach_light
0x694.desc: Adds a light index to the object's render instance light list (+0x1A0 / +0x1A4, FUN_004d04d0; no duplicates) - lights a model by that scene light. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x698.name: enable_light_effects
0x698.desc: FUN_0051c070: allocates the light's fader (entry +0xE0, flag 0x40) and flicker controller (+0xDC, flag 0x100) - needed before the fades of +0x680/+0x688 and the effects +0x69C..+0x6A4. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x69C.name: light_flicker_switch
0x69C.desc: FUN_0051c190 (needs +0x698): flicker controller mode 5 (FUN_0055a870) - the light jumps at random between colour_a and colour_b every interval; use_light_colours = the light's own colours. Exact meaning of the timing args not verified. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x6A0.name: light_flicker_blend
0x6A0.desc: FUN_0051c210: like +0x69C with mode 6 - random blends between the two colours (flicker controller bit 2). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x6A4.name: light_flicker_mode4
0x6A4.desc: FUN_0051c290: like +0x69C with mode 4 (random switching, controller bit 4 only). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x6A8.name: stop_light_effect
0x6A8.desc: FUN_0051c310: restores the light (FUN_0051d720) and clears flag 0x200 (effect running) set by +0x69C..+0x6A4. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x6AC.name: show_message
0x6AC.desc: Looks up a catalog text (0x4F6730) and shows it in the bottom pop-up bar (FUN_004d33a0 on view controller [0x63C98C]) for the given ms (all sites 5000).

0x6B0.name: show_message_raw
0x6B0.desc: Shows a plain string in the bottom pop-up bar for duration_ms (FUN_004d33a0 on view controller [0x63C98C]) - +0x6AC without the catalog lookup. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x6B4.name: show_message_value
0x6B4.desc: 0x488910: looks up the catalog text (FUN_004F6730), sprintf's the value into it and shows it in the pop-up bar (view controller [0x63C98C] FUN_004D33A0(text, ms)). MP DLLs: SEC_REMAIN '%d Seconds Remaining', 3000 ms.

0x6B8.name: debug_printf
0x6B8.desc: Debug printf (MP DLLs pass format strings such as 'LevelEventVehicleDestroyed() - Unable to work out unifrom of at...'); handler 0x488980 is a bare ret in the shipped exe (no-op, like +0x30C).

0x6BC.name: set_health_percent
0x6BC.desc: Sets health +0x54 = max health (FUN_0049c580) x percent / 100, percent clamped to 0..100. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x6C0.name: set_view_controller_74
0x6C0.desc: Writes view controller [0x63C98C] +0x74 (FUN_004d2460; also zeroed at init and by a front-end screen at 0x45D306); no reader found - effect unknown. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x6C4.name: emitter_start
0x6C4.desc: Starts/restarts emitter n of the emitter list [0x60EDD8] (+4 array of 0x7C-byte entries): resets its timers and sets flags +0x70 bit 0 (on) (FUN_004f31f0).

0x6C8.name: emitter_stop
0x6C8.desc: Stops emitter n of [0x60EDD8]: clears flags +0x70 bit 0 and +0x74.

0x6CC.name: set_attack_target
0x6CC.desc: Clears the soldier's 3-entry target list (+0x290), puts target in it (FUN_00407040, may send message 0x34 'enemy spotted'), makes it the current target (FUN_00406390), sets +0x2564/+0x2568 = 1, +0x2B60 = 0 and +0x29D8/+0x29DC = value. Only called from cutscene-queue callbacks.

0x6D0.name: add_attack_target
0x6D0.desc: Like 0x6CC but keeps the existing target list: adds target, makes it current, +0x2568 = 1, +0x29D8/+0x29DC = value.

0x6D4.name: aim_at_object_node
0x6D4.desc: Computes the direction from the soldier's connector 0x13 (FUN_0042ea70) to the target's node/connector 'node', normalises the angles to +-180, stores them as the soldier's aim angles (+0x374, FUN_0049e7b0) and sets AI mode 8 (FUN_0049d870).

0x6D8.name: soldier_signal_action
0x6D8.desc: FUN_00408990 on the soldier: plays movement-state action 9 (or animation 0x4D via vtable+0x70); if one played, plays sound 2 of the bank of vtable+0x74's object at the soldier and posts a 500-unit AI hearing event; returns 1, else 0. Exact action unknown (gesture/shout?).

0x6DC.name: add_screen_marker
0x6DC.desc: 0x489250: takes a free entry of the 2-entry table 0x618360 (6 dwords, -1 = free, FUN_0048C2E0) and fills it (FUN_0048C330: two ids + four ints converted from floats). Purpose not identified; name is a guess. Not referenced by the six MP DLLs.

0x6E0.name: is_network_game
0x6E0.desc: Returns [0x610F5C] (FUN_004608E0) = the DirectPlay multiplayer flag. 0 when the level runs without a network session. Network-role query.

0x6E4.name: is_network_host
0x6E4.desc: FUN_004608F0: 1 when [0x610F60] (session active, FUN_004608D0) and the DP8 session object [0x770154]+4 -> +0xA8 (host flag, FUN_00563700) are set; 0 offline. The DLLs gate scoring / win checks / event broadcasts on it. Network-role query.

0x6E8.name: is_network_client
0x6E8.desc: FUN_00460920: 1 when [0x610F60] and session +4 -> +0xB0 (client flag, FUN_00563F70); 0 offline. DLLs skip host-side item / respawn logic when it is 1. Network-role query.

0x6EC.name: is_respawn_enabled
0x6EC.desc: Returns the lobby option RE-SPAWN, byte [0x5EBBA9] (FUN_004609A0; set by the host OPTIONS screen item 0xE14 via FUN_0045F8D0).

0x6F0.name: get_player_team
0x6F0.desc: FUN_00460A40: team byte (+0x15, [0x610DB9 + slot*0x34]) of the MP player-table slot owned by the soldier (slot = FUN_004607E0(obj, 1) = index in the player object list); -1 = the local player's slot [0x610F84]. DLLs pass the result to +0x7D4.

0x6F4.name: queue_noop_event
0x6F4.desc: Pushes an event on the event queue [0x63C978] (FUN_004db6b0) whose callback 0x488F00 is a bare ret: args at +0x30/+0x34/+0x38, delay +0x10, flags +0x14, type 3 if repeat else 6. Does nothing useful on PC. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x6F8.name: play_object_anim
0x6F8.desc: Plays an animation on a non-soldier object whose model is a hierarchy (model type 4, e.g. vehicles/props): FUN_00501c20(slot 0, anim, flag, 0, 3.0). anim 0 stops it (the movie clean-up uses it that way).

0x6FC.name: show_zone
0x6FC.desc: Makes a world zone visible: clears flag 4 (hidden) on zone +0xC (FUN_004d1230). Zone pointer from 0x704. Mission 2 shows its BMP1WRECK / LIMO_BODY_DAMAGED zones with it later in the mission.

0x700.name: hide_zone
0x700.desc: Hides a world zone: sets flag 4 on zone +0xC (FUN_004d1220; the same flag object removal sets); null-safe. Mission 2 uses it at set-up on the wreck / damaged zones.

0x704.name: find_zone
0x704.desc: Finds a world zone by name (hash FUN_004b9ab0 compared with zone +0x210 in the world's zone list [0x63C948]+0x1A48, next +0xB0); returns the zone pointer or 0.

0x708.name: get_time_seconds
0x708.desc: 0x488FE0: timer [0x63C954] +0x10 (total ms) / +4 (units) as a float = game time in seconds.

0x70C.name: get_game_clock_seconds
0x70C.desc: Total time of the gameplay timer [0x63C958] (+0x10 ms / units +4) in seconds (st0). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x710.name: get_flag_60ee38
0x710.desc: Returns [0x60EE38]; only ever written 0 (start-up option check at 0x40FEDD) - always 0 on PC. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x714.name: stub_714
0x714.desc: Bare ret - no-op on PC. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x718.name: camera_zoom_in
0x718.desc: Jumps to FUN_00444330: steps the current player's camera FOV in (zoom), clamped to the held weapon's zoom limit, with the scope zoom sound - the zoom key handler.

0x71C.name: camera_zoom_out
0x71C.desc: Jumps to FUN_00444130: steps the current player's camera FOV back out towards 70 degrees - the zoom-out counterpart of +0x718. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x720.name: shake_vehicle
0x720.desc: Starts a camera shake on view 0's camera (FUN_004d5760(strength, 0, duration), as +0x32C) and a jolt on a ground vehicle (FUN_004394c0: wheeled +0x2C18 / tracked +0x2C1C body, +0x2C68 = strength x body value, +0x2C6C = duration). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x724.name: return_control_to_leader
0x724.desc: Gives player 1 (block 0x60F5B8, FUN_0044f260) the first soldier of team 0's list (FUN_004c9720), sets the player camera mode 1 (FUN_00472b30 / FUN_00473110), places the view-0 camera (FUN_004db330(cam, 0, blend)) and keeps the soldier's view angles +0x310. Probably for the end of a cutscene. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x728.name: show_movie_text
0x728.desc: Looks up a level text by hash in the mission string table (FUN_004f5e80) and adds it, line by line, to the subtitle/text box of view n ([0x60ED14+n*4], FUN_00508ed0); shows 'WARNING : MISSING MOVIE TEXT' if absent.

0x72C.name: movie_restore_objects
0x72C.desc: Movie clean-up over all objects (callback 0x486860): cutscene actors (instance flag 0x20000) get their animation stopped and are deactivated; objects the movie start hid (flag 0x40000, see 0x7D8) are reactivated.

0x730.name: set_sky
0x730.desc: Applies a loaded .sky record (from 0x734) to the atmosphere: FUN_004e2be0 sets sky, fog colour and fog distances (+0x40/+0x44 -> atmosphere +4/+0xC) and the far clip.

0x734.name: load_sky
0x734.desc: Loads a .sky file (e.g. 'Mid_day_sunny.sky') into the next free sky slot and writes the slot pointer to *out (for 0x730).

0x738.name: init_skies
0x738.desc: Allocates count sky slots (0x84 B each) for 0x734; called before loading skies (count 2 in Missions 1/4/8/9).

0x73C.name: load_pending_textures
0x73C.desc: Loads every registered texture not loaded yet (texture batch FUN_0054a3e0 on [0x63C930], no progress callback) - after mid-level skin / model changes. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x740.name: set_movie_text_colour
0x740.desc: Sets the colour (0-1 floats, alpha 1) of view n's subtitle / text box [0x60ED14+n*4] used by +0x728 (FUN_00508ac0 -> box +4 as 0xFFRRGGBB). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x744.name: get_game_mode
0x744.returns: int (0 team deathmatch, 1 deathmatch, 2 recovery, 3 assault/defend, 4 VIP assassination)
0x744.desc: FUN_004609F0: maps the lobby GAME TYPE menu index [0x5EBBA5] (0 RECOVERY, 1 TEAM DEATHMATCH, 2 DEATHMATCH, 3 ASSAULT/DEFEND, 4 VIP ASSASSINATION; item 0xDAE) through {2,0,1,3,4,5,6}. Each MP DLL switches its per-mode set-up, update and network-event handlers on it.

0x748.name: get_time_limit_ms
0x748.desc: FUN_00461060: (time-limit index [0x5EBBA6] + 1) x 300000 ms (5..20 min); index 4 (1 500 000) returns -1 = unlimited. Lobby option TIME LIMIT (item 0xE11).

0x74C.name: get_time_remaining_ms
0x74C.desc: 0x488AA0: +0x748 time limit minus +0x750 network game time; -1 when unlimited. DLLs end the round when it reaches <= 0 (host only).

0x750.name: get_network_time_ms
0x750.desc: FUN_00461090: shared DirectPlay session clock (FUN_00562BF0 on [0x770154]: host +0x44C / client +0x99C after a timer update); -1 when [0x770154] is null (offline). Also stamped into kill / respawn messages.

0x754.name: count_living_players
0x754.desc: FUN_00460BB0: counts MP player-table slots (8 x 0x34 at 0x610DA4) with team != 3 that are on the team (2 = any) and whose dead flag +0x17 ([0x610DBB], set by the kill report) is 0. Used for last-man-standing checks.

0x758.name: mp_send_text
0x758.desc: FUN_00463100(text, value, -1): builds a network message type 0x1A with up to 0x4C characters of text from the local player and sends it through the server or client (FUN_005629e0 / FUN_00562ac0). Only when networked. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x75C.name: is_artillery_enabled
0x75C.desc: Returns the lobby option ARTILLERY SUPPORT, byte [0x5EBBA8] (FUN_004609B0; item 0xE13).

0x760.name: is_weapon_caches_enabled
0x760.desc: Returns the lobby option WEAPON CACHES, byte [0x5EBBA7] (FUN_004609E0; item 0xE12).

0x764.name: mp_latest_player
0x764.desc: Script id of the soldier of the team's multiplayer player with the most recent time stamp (record +4, min of now - t; FUN_00460ae0). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x768.name: get_team_score
0x768.desc: FUN_00460B60: sum of the score field +0x20 ([0x610DC4]) of every used player slot on the team (kills +1, team kills -2 via the kill report).

0x76C.name: mp_team_in_region
0x76C.desc: 1 when any of the team's multiplayer players' soldiers is inside the region ([0x63C9B8] FUN_004fc600, test FUN_004fc040) - FUN_00460bf0. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x770.name: get_random_team_player
0x770.desc: FUN_00460CC0: picks a random player slot on the team (FUN_004B7E60 over +0x778's count) and returns its soldier's script id (player object list FUN_00460830(i,1) +8). VIP mode uses it to choose the VIP.

0x774.name: set_player_team
0x774.desc: FUN_00460D40: writes the slot's pending-team byte +0x2C ([0x610DD0]) = team; when host in network state 7 it also sends the player table (FUN_00462820, class 0x1B) and raises script message 0x00 KILLED (player, -1, network time) so the soldier respawns on the new side; offline returns -1 after only storing the byte.

0x778.name: count_team_players
0x778.desc: FUN_00460DD0: number of used player-table slots (team byte != 3) on the team (2 = all players).

0x77C.name: respawn_soldier_at_waypoint
0x77C.desc: FUN_00460EC0: waypoint position / rotation (FUN_004D13F0 / FUN_004D1400), offset 100 cm by a rotating corner counter [0x610F8C] so respawns don't stack, then FUN_0041D800 on the soldier: respawn target +0x1FC / rotation +0x208, health +0x1F4 = pct x 0.01 x max, respawn pending +0x25DC = 1 at time +0x25D8 = now + delay (MP DLLs: 100.0 with 0 or 2000 ms).

0x780.name: find_item_carrier
0x780.desc: FUN_00460FB0: scans the inventories (+0x26B8, 25 slots) of the players on the team for the item id; returns the carrying soldier (flag / case carrier checks).

0x784.name: report_player_killed
0x784.desc: FUN_004632D0: only when is_network_game and network state [0x5EBBAC] = 7 (in game): sends class 0x1A subtype 2 (victim slot, killer slot, time). The receiver FUN_00466220 increments the victim's deaths +0x1C, sets dead flag +0x17, kill time +0x18, gives the killer +1 score (-2 for a team kill unless deathmatch) and prints ENEMY DOWN / SQUAD MEMBER DOWN; a client's report is relayed by the host. Does nothing offline.

0x788.name: resupply_soldier_ammo
0x788.desc: 0x488BB0: if the soldier (type 1) holds a gun (held item type 6; not weapon class 6 / 0xE / 9, not a throwable FUN_004A4C60, not category 8) refills its reserve to 'magazines' magazines via FUN_004A5210(magazines, cooldown), at most once per cooldown. The per-soldier core of +0x7A4 (which adds the local-player / region test); usable for any soldier. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x78C.name: register_mp_item
0x78C.desc: Adds an item object to MP item spawner 'kind' (1 -> 0x619E50, 2 -> 0x619CF0, 3 -> 0x619B90; FUN_004A6380): put in the spawner's 20-entry pool (+0x10C, unless already placed), deactivated (vtable+4(0)), item +0x70 = spawner kind (+0x18), weapons get magazines vtable+0x38(3). The spawner later places pooled items on its spawn points.

0x790.name: add_mp_item_spawn_point
0x790.desc: FUN_004A62F0 on spawner 'kind': appends a spawn point at the waypoint's position (+0x1C + n*0x18: pos, freed time = now, item 0, marker object id) and deactivates the marker object; kinds 2/3 pass -1 as marker.

0x794.name: mp_item_taken
0x794.returns: int (0, -1 if the item has no spawner kind)
0x794.desc: FUN_004A6510 on the item's spawner (item +0x70 kind): clears the spawn point holding the item, stamps its freed time (respawn countdown starts) and deactivates its marker object. Called when a player picks up / uses a spawner item.

0x798.name: set_mp_item_respawn_delay
0x798.desc: 0x488C90: writes MP item spawner 'kind' +4 (1 -> [0x619E54], 2 -> [0x619CF4], 3 -> [0x619B94]) = the delay before a freed spawn point gets the next pooled item (see +0x7A0 / +0x790). Same argument order as +0x7A0. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x79C.name: drop_mp_items
0x79C.desc: FUN_004A6970: removes every item with an MP spawner kind (+0x70) from the soldier's inventory (FUN_004318A0); kind 1/3 go straight back to their spawner (FUN_004A6380), kind 2 only when script query message 0x2C answers yes. Used when a carrier dies.

0x7A0.name: set_mp_item_spawner_enabled
0x7A0.desc: Writes spawner 'kind' +0 (1 -> [0x619E50], 2 -> [0x619CF0], 3 -> [0x619B90]); the per-frame spawner update FUN_004A6260 (from 0x40FB72) only runs when it is set and not on a network client: a free spawn point older than the delay (+4) gets the next pooled item (FUN_004A6470).

0x7A4.name: resupply_local_player_in_region
0x7A4.desc: If the local player's soldier ([0x610F84] slot) stands in the region (FUN_00483190) and holds a gun (not C4 / knife / fist / throwable / category 8), refills its reserve to 'magazines' magazines through FUN_004A5210, at most once per cooldown (weapon +0x8C). MP DLLs: regions 2/3, 3 mags, 20000 ms (base ammo boxes).

0x7A8.name: broadcast_mp_event
0x7A8.desc: FUN_004638F0: when is_network_game and state 7, sends class 0x1A subtype 6 (event id); the receiver FUN_004668E0 raises script message 0x36 with the id (a client's request is re-broadcast by the host). This is how the MP DLLs sync game events (flag taken, VIP down, time up 0x3E ...). Nothing happens offline - no message 0x36.

0x7AC.name: return_item_to_waypoint
0x7AC.desc: FUN_00461130: takes the item out of any player's inventory, moves it to the waypoint (rotation too unless it is a weapon, type 6; FUN_004C9F20 snap) and activates it (vtable+4(1)). Recovery flag / case reset.

0x7B0.name: drop_inventory_item
0x7B0.desc: 0x486480: finds the item id in the soldier's inventory; on the network host sends the drop as an HLO event (FUN_0041E310(5, item), class 0x14), otherwise drops it locally (FUN_00431C70(item, 0)).

0x7B4.name: get_player_count
0x7B4.desc: Returns the number of local players (input blocks, [0x610798] & 0xFFFF); scripts test > 1 for split screen.

0x7B8.name: end_mp_game
0x7B8.desc: Host only (is_network_host): FUN_00462040(8, team) sends class 0x1B subtype 3; receivers store [0x5EBB44] = winner and network state [0x5EBBAC] = 8 (results screen: '%s WIN' with the team's uniform name, or TEAMS DRAW; 0x4707D2). No effect offline.

0x7BC.name: set_movie_version
0x7BC.desc: Records the movie/cutscene data version ([0x5ED11C], first call wins); warns 'We have different movie versions used together' if another one was set. All sites pass 9.

0x7C0.name: get_movie_version
0x7C0.desc: Returns the movie version set by 0x7BC; the cutscene command code branches on > 5.

0x7C4.name: set_vehicle_free
0x7C4.desc: Vehicles only (object type 0): false sets vehicle flag +0x2CD8 bit 2, true clears it; the bit is passed to the vehicle dynamics (+0x2C20/+0x2C24, FUN_005192b0/0x51a350) - looks like a brake/hold. Used by cutscene command callbacks.

0x7C8.name: reset_mp_item_spawner
0x7C8.desc: FUN_004A61D0 on spawner 'kind': clears enable / delay / counts, the 20-entry pool and all 10 spawn points (freed time = now, marker -1). DLLs call it for kinds 1-3 at level start.

0x7CC.name: stub_7cc
0x7CC.desc: 0x489580: bare ret - no-op on PC. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x7D0.name: show_briefing
0x7D0.desc: Switches the front end to state 0x14 = the mission briefing popup.

0x7D4.name: get_team_uniform
0x7D4.returns: int (uniform: 0 SAS, 1 US Delta, 2 Russian, 3 Iraqi)
0x7D4.desc: 0x461100: lobby faction byte of team 0 ([0x5EBBA3]) or team 1 ([0x5EBBA4]) mapped through {0,1,3,2} (FUN_004613D0) to the engine's skin side; other teams -> 0. DLLs pick which flag / VIP / vehicle objects to activate from it.

0x7D8.name: set_movie_hides_world
0x7D8.desc: Sets [0x617DCC]: when on, MovieStart (0x594) deactivates every active non-cutscene object (marking it 0x40000) so only cutscene actors remain; 0x72C brings them back.

0x7DC.name: play_sound_at_object
0x7DC.desc: Plays a sound id from a bank (FUN_0055de20) at the object's position, tagged with the object (+0x4C) so 0x7E4 can test it; distance e.g. 1000.0 / 10000.0.

0x7E0.name: play_object_sound_2d
0x7E0.desc: Plays a sound id from a bank non-positionally (no position, distance 0), tagged with the object's sound tag (+0x4C).

0x7E4.name: object_sound_playing
0x7E4.desc: 1 while any sound tagged with this object (+0x4C) is still playing (FUN_0055e130), else 0. Scripts wait on it before the next line.

0x7E8.name: kill_with_anim
0x7E8.desc: Kills the soldier: damage = 2 x health (+0x54) via vtable+0x3C, then vtable+0x70(anim) plays the given animation/state (death animation).

0x7EC.name: kill_soldier
0x7EC.desc: FUN_0042b1b0: health +0x54 = 0, damage 1.0 via vtable+0x3C, death time backdated 180 s (+0x2A08) - instant death / corpse. Used in loops over soldier lists.

0x7F0.name: set_viewfinder_colour
0x7F0.desc: Sets the cutscene viewfinder overlay colour [0x61841C] = ARGB from 0..1 floats (x255).

0x7F4.name: viewfinder_on
0x7F4.desc: Shows the camcorder-style viewfinder overlay ([0x618418] = 1) used in mission overviews.

0x7FC.name: set_sound_mode
0x7FC.desc: Sound manager FUN_0055f270(mode, 1): requests sound context 'mode' (+0x14 = 1 when it differs from the current +0x10). Called with 1 before MovieStart and 0 when the movie/briefing ends - movie vs game sound mode.

0x800.name: set_sound_mode_2
0x800.desc: 0x4896D0: FUN_0055F270(mode, 1) on the sound manager [0x63C9AC] - identical body to +0x7FC set_sound_mode.

0x804.name: explosion_at_position
0x804.desc: 0x4896F0: queues an explosion event at (x, y, z) in the explosion manager [0x63C9D0] (FUN_004E92C0, 20-entry ring; the same call the weapon code makes with weapon def +0xD4 / +0xD8 at 0x4A1A73, and destructible props at 0x41A524) with zone = the given object's +0x1C, no attacker, flags 0x5B0A (bit 0x100 = flash / rumble near the camera, read at 0x40E3E4). Event lifetime = radius x 0.667 ms (min 1 s). radius / damage named from the weapon call; exact effect not seen in game. Called by Mission11b.

0x808.name: set_unused_floats_5ec070
0x808.desc: 0x489A60: writes [0x5EC070..0x5EC07C] (defaults 0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.3); nothing else in the exe references these addresses (or the table around them at 0x5EC060), so it has no effect on PC. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x80C.name: get_vehicle_driver
0x80C.desc: Returns the script id of the first occupied crew seat of a vehicle (FUN_0043d440: seat flags +0x260C / occupants +0x2608, starting at the driver seat), or -1.

0x810.name: show_text_screen
0x810.desc: Draws a full-screen page with the catalog text and 'press any key' (FUN_0040b1e0, background colour) and blocks until a key / button / mouse press (FUN_00539a20(0)).

0x814.name: set_rotation_from_waypoint
0x814.desc: 0x4839D0: turns the object to the waypoint's rotation (FUN_004D1400 on the waypoint table [0x63C9B0] -> rotation setter FUN_004C9A70). Position unchanged - pair with a teleport / place call. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x818.name: hash_name
0x818.desc: Returns the engine's name hash (FUN_004b9ab0, lower-case LFSR as used for zone / texture names).

0x81C.name: sort_desc
0x81C.desc: Bubble-sorts an array of count uint32 values in descending order (utility).

0x820.name: sort_desc_zero_terminated
0x820.desc: Bubble-sorts a zero-terminated uint32 array in descending order (utility).

0x824.name: set_vehicle_flag_10
0x824.desc: Vehicle: on sets +0x2CD8 bit 4 (0x10) and +0x2E8 = 360.0, +0x2EC = 180.0 (full angle ranges, probably turret / sight arcs); off clears the bit. When set and the vehicle is stopped its dynamics inputs are zeroed (0x43A14C).

0x828.name: move_to_waypoint_direct
0x828.desc: 0x489B90: same body as +0x130 minus its soldier-type check: FUN_0045BA10(soldier, waypoint position) = mover (+0x3A0, FUN_0050D170) target set to the point with the route cleared, soldier +0x224 = target, movement mode 2 (FUN_0049D4A0) + FUN_0049D870(4) - sends the soldier straight to the waypoint's position. Returns nothing (+0x130 returns 1). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x82C.name: explosion_at_waypoint
0x82C.desc: 0x489730: like +0x804 but at the waypoint's position (FUN_004D13F0), zone 0: explosion event in [0x63C9D0] (FUN_004E92C0) with flags by type: 0 -> 0x5B0A (as +0x804), 1 -> 0x5B1A, 2 -> 0x1B02. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x830.name: movie_freeze_world
0x830.desc: Pauses timer [0x63C954] (FUN_004ba560(0)) and points the camera manager's clock at the main timer [0x63C958]; with 1 also hides (render flag 4) every active object that isn't type 2/3.

0x834.name: movie_unfreeze_world
0x834.desc: 0x4869C0: undoes +0x830: restarts timer [0x63C954] (FUN_004BA560(1)), points the camera manager's clock back at it (FUN_004D4590), and for every object (FUN_004CA910, callback 0x486950) that is in play, answers vtable+0x1C and whose render instance lacks flag 0x20000 clears the hide flag 4 (FUN_004D1230). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x838.name: set_node_rotation
0x838.desc: Gives the object's render instance a node override controller (+0x2C4) for the model node named 'node' (archive hash) with the given vector - Mission 3 turns its RADARDISH this way.

0x83C.name: is_language_unset
0x83C.desc: PS2: 'language not chosen yet' flag (starts 1, cleared when a language is picked; front end shows the language screen); on PC the flag [0x60ED38] is never set, so always 0. 0x489C50: returns [0x60ED38], a .bss dword only ever cleared (by the debug 'next language' key handler 0x444DF0) - effectively always 0 on PC. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x840.name: remove_vehicles_in_region
0x840.desc: Takes every type-0 object (vehicles / props) whose position is inside the region out of play (FUN_004c93a0: in-play bit cleared, hidden, moved to the inactive list).

0x844.name: remove_corpses_in_region
0x844.desc: 0x4810E0: region by index (FUN_004FC600 on [0x63C9B8]); the corpse manager [0x60F1F4] (HLOCorpse.cpp, CORPSEHOLDER objects) takes every in-play corpse whose position is inside the region out of play (FUN_0041B4F0 -> FUN_004C93A0). Companion of +0x840. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x848.name: tint_soldier_red
0x848.desc: FUN_00436b10: applies colour (0.5, 0, 0, 1) with value 15.0 to the soldier's skinned mesh (FUN_005019f0 -> 0x528990) - likely a blood / damage tint.

0x84C.name: has_startup_flag
0x84C.desc: FUN_004b9cd0: 1 if the start-up option letter is set (Training 3 checks 'u', the dev movie-skip flag).

0x850.name: reset_idle_timer
0x850.desc: FUN_005383E0: [0x754C90] = -(timer [0x63C954]+0x10 x 0.001) so the input idle time (+0x854) restarts from 0.

0x854.name: get_idle_time
0x854.desc: FUN_00538410: seconds since the last input (timer x 0.001 - last input [0x754C8C] + [0x754C90]); the front end uses it for the attract-mode film.

0x860.name: set_squad_banter
0x860.desc: Sets [0x5E91F4] (1 by default): enables squad idle speech 0xFD8 when a squad mate is near and in view (FUN_0042af80). Training 3 only.

0x864.name: set_flag_5f5678
0x864.desc: Sets [0x5F5678] (equipment ctor sets 1): when on, equipment items get +0x64 = 1 (FUN_004a4a10). Training 3 only; meaning unclear.

0x868.name: set_auto_target_assist
0x868.desc: Sets [0x5F567C]: enables FUN_00435760 (the player's soldier picks a nearby / aimed combat soldier within 2 m as a target) and an inventory check at 0x45335D. Mission 1 turns it off then on; Training 3 too.

0x86C.name: activate_object_simple
0x86C.desc: 0x483600: SetActive(1) (vtable+4) unless already in play (+0xC bit 0). Unlike +0xC4 it doesn't record the object in the zone object table (FUN_00482410) or run the network vehicle step. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x870.name: deactivate_object_simple
0x870.desc: 0x483630: SetActive(0) (vtable+4(0)) only; +0xC8 additionally calls FUN_00482410(obj, 0). Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x874.name: screen_dim_down
0x874.desc: 0x48A410: view controller [0x63C98C] +0x2C8 = -1000 / (time/2) (FUN_004D4500) = per-frame rate (x dt, 0x4D1BE9) of its extra level +0x2C4 (clamped 0..0.5; +4 = max(base, +0x2C4)). Lowers it; opposite of +0x878. Likely a screen fade / dim - visual not checked. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x878.name: screen_dim_up
0x878.desc: 0x48A450: view controller [0x63C98C] +0x2C8 = +1000 / (time/2): ramps its extra level +0x2C4 up to 0.5 (see +0x874). Likely fades / dims the view - visual not checked. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x87C.name: save_soldier_states
0x87C.desc: 0x48A0A0: allocates (FUN_00489FD0) and fills the array [0x618358] (count [0x618354], 0x28 B each) with every soldier of every team (active + inactive lists): object, position, rotation, +0x1C twice, active bit (+0xC & 1).

0x880.name: restore_soldier_states
0x880.desc: 0x48A250: puts every soldier saved by +0x87C back: render-instance vtable[0](pos), rotation FUN_004C9A70, FUN_004C9980 / FUN_004C9A00 (+0x1C fields), SetActive(saved bit).

0x884.name: reset_world_state
0x884.desc: 0x48A3B0: clears effects / projectiles / decals etc. (FUN_00486EB0), empties the event queue [0x63C978] (FUN_004DB630), resets every soldier's AI / movement / held item (FUN_00489E40), removes dead soldiers (FUN_0048A2E0), then FUN_00486650. Round-restart helper.

0x88C.name: reset_all_soldiers
0x88C.desc: 0x489E40: for every team's active (FUN_004C9720(team, 1)) and inactive (FUN_004C96D0) soldier lists: soldiers not in a vehicle (+0x267C = 0) get vtable+0x40 (reset), +0x258 / +0x260 moved to +0x25C / +0x264 and cleared, FUN_0049EA30(0, 0), held item FUN_004A4A30(0). Part of +0x884 reset_world_state. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x890.name: stub_890
0x890.desc: 0x48A2D0: bare ret - no-op on PC. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x894.name: restore_destroyed_objects
0x894.desc: 0x48A2E0: for every team's active / inactive lists of object kind 3 (FUN_004C9720 / FUN_004C96D0(team, 3)): objects with health +0x54 < 1.0 get FUN_0041A1C0 = flag 0x400 cleared, +0x60 = 0, health back to the definition's max (unit +0x80 -> +0x24). Part of +0x884 reset_world_state. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x898.name: stub_898
0x898.desc: 0x48A3A0: bare ret - no-op on PC. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x89C.name: is_at_main_menu
0x89C.desc: 0x480D80: 0 during a network session ([0x610F60]) or front-end state 0x2E; else 1 when the front-end state [0x617C18] is 1 (main menu).

0x8A0.name: get_player_effective_team
0x8A0.desc: FUN_00460E70: the slot's pending team +0x2C ([0x610DD0]) if set (!= 3), else its current team +0x15.

0x8A4.name: allow_stance_0
0x8A4.desc: Sets [0x5F5668]: while 0, soldiers can't switch to stance 0 (FUN_0045cf00 refuses). Training 1/3 use it to unlock a stance (probably prone/crouch) for the tutorial.

0x8A8.name: get_local_player_count
0x8A8.desc: PC: always returns 1 (stub). PS2 (demo 0x188BB8, retail 0x156A78): [split-screen flag] ? 2 : 1 = local players - the PC mission scripts still branch on it for 2-player co-op (Foley controllable, pickups hidden, cell door). Always returns 1 (stub). Mission scripts test the result > 1 (left-over multiplayer / player-count check).

0x8AC.name: disable_cutscene_head_reset
0x8AC.desc: Clears [0x60F20C] (soldier ctor sets 1); while set, soldiers' view / head angles (+0x310..) are zeroed during cinematics (0x42E4CF).

0x8B0.name: enable_cutscene_head_reset
0x8B0.desc: 0x480E20: [0x60F20C] = 1 (the soldier ctor default) - counterpart of +0x8AC: soldiers' view / head angles are zeroed during cinematics again. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x8B4.name: get_mp_item_kind
0x8B4.desc: 0x488E50: +0x70 of an equipment / weapon object (types 5 / 6) = the MP spawner kind set by +0x78C; 0 for other objects.

0x8B8.name: disable_idle_timer
0x8B8.desc: FUN_00538450: [0x754C90] = FLT_MAX so the input idle time never runs out (no attract-mode film).

0x8BC.name: take_play_intro_flag
0x8BC.desc: 0x48A4D0: returns [0x5ED230] and clears it (initially 1): FrontEnd.dll asks once whether to play the opening film.

0x8C0.name: get_value_8c0
0x8C0.desc: Returns **(handle+0x18) as a float (FUN_004d0e30), 0.0 for a null handle; 0x8C4 is the matching setter. Mission 12B doubles the result.

0x8C4.name: damage_breakable
0x8C4.desc: 0x48A530: for a non-null breakable scene instance (FUN_004D0E80: needs instance flag 0x400000 = ENVI breakable block and health **(handle+0x18) > 0) subtracts amount from its health; reaching 0 runs the break code. Matching getter = +0x8C0. Called by Mission12B.

0x8C8.name: push_dynamic_object
0x8C8.desc: 0x48A550: object type 2 only: its dynamics (+0x64) get FUN_00512480(direction, strength, 0) = if strength != 0 and the body is dynamic (+8 = 1) wakes the Karma body (0x58E780) and adds force direction x strength (0x58EA10). Direction is a pointer to 3 floats. Unused by the shipped DLLs.

0x8CC.name: spawn_debris_at_waypoint
0x8CC.desc: Spawns a particle / debris burst of effect type (table [0x63C9C8], index & 0x3FF; FUN_0054c5c0) at waypoint n's position / direction ([0x63C9B0], 0x20-byte entries). Mission 1 uses waypoints 0x154-0x15D with type 0x2C (explosions).

0x8D0.name: set_view_camera
0x8D0.desc: Makes camera n the active camera of view / viewport v (camera manager FUN_004d4f80), resets the view controller; for camera != 0 also starts a ramp (1.0 -> 5.0) on timer [0x63C954].

0x8D4.name: get_soldier_view
0x8D4.desc: Returns the viewport index (+0x474 of the controlling input block +0x23C0) of a player-controlled soldier, -1 if no player drives it.
